Alutiiq people hunted sea mammals and fished along its shores, moving between settlements as resources and circumstances changed. Russian fur seekers reached the island in the 1780s; a village identified by Afognak elders with the later Alutiiq settlement was recorded in Russian censuses in 1795 and 1804.
simp_chinese: 阿格瓦内克是阿留提克人与阿福格纳克岛相关的地名。该岛位于科迪亚克岛北面，海湾与鲑鱼溪流数千年来养育着海上居民。阿留提克人沿岸捕鱼、猎取海兽，并随着资源与环境变化在聚落之间迁徙。俄国毛皮商人在1780年代抵达此岛；阿福格纳克长者将俄国1795年和1804年人口记录中的一个村落与后来的阿留提克聚落联系起来。

english: Agwarmin, also known as Ewamian, country lies in inland northern Queensland around the upper Gilbert, Einasleigh and Copperfield rivers. Its people are neighbours of the Mbara to the south and other Aboriginal groups to the west. The river headwaters cross a landscape of wooded country and seasonal streams.
simp_chinese: 阿格瓦尔明亦称埃瓦米安，其土地位于昆士兰北部内陆的吉尔伯特河、艾纳斯利河与科珀菲尔德河上游一带。南方邻族为姆巴拉人，西方还有其他原住民群体。河流源头穿过林地与季节性溪流组成的景观。

english: Aha Macav is the homeland of the Mojave people along the Colorado River. Their territory stretched from Black Canyon south past the Mojave Valley, where settlements and fields occupied the river’s floodplain. The river also figures in Mojave accounts of creation, as the source of water, fish and waterfowl in a desert landscape. In 1604–1605 Juan de Oñate’s expedition travelled through the lower Colorado country. A century and a half later, the Franciscan Francisco Garcés visited the Mojave in 1775, encountering communities whose lives and relationships were rooted in the river valley.
simp_chinese: 阿哈马卡夫是莫哈韦人的故土，沿科罗拉多河从黑峡谷向南延伸，越过莫哈韦河谷。河流泛滥平原上分布着聚落和田地。在莫哈韦人的创世传说中，这条河也占有重要地位，为沙漠带来水、鱼和水禽。1604至1605年，胡安·德·奥尼亚特的远征队穿过科罗拉多河下游地区。一个半世纪之后，方济各会士弗朗西斯科·加尔塞斯于1775年访问莫哈韦人，遇见了生活与社会关系深植于河谷的社群。

english: Ahar lies in the uplands of Qaradagh, north of the Sabalan massif. Its monuments include the Friday Mosque and the shrine of the Sufi master Shihab al-Din Ahari. The shrine received attention from the Safavid court and was renovated in 1608. For much of the Safavid period the governorship of the Ahar region remained in the hands of the descendants and relatives of Khalifa Ilyas Qarajadaghi.
simp_chinese: 阿哈尔坐落在萨巴兰山地以北的卡拉达格高地。城中建筑包括主麻清真寺和苏菲导师希哈布丁·阿哈里的陵墓。陵墓受到萨法维王廷重视，曾于1608年修缮。萨法维时期的大部分时间，阿哈尔地区总督职位由哈里发伊利亚斯·卡拉贾达吉的后代及亲属掌握。

english: Ahaus grew around a noble residence on the Aa, recorded about 1030. The lords of Ahaus built a castle here in the twelfth century and held a small Westphalian lordship amid the territories of more powerful neighbours. After a dispute over allegiance, the prince-bishop of Münster destroyed their castles of Ahaus and Diepenheim in 1177, although the family retained its lordship. The castle settlement received an excise privilege in 1389 and town rights two years later. In 1406 Bishop Otto IV of Hoya bought the lordship and incorporated it into Münster. Ahaus became the centre of an administrative district encompassing parishes across western Münsterland, an arrangement that lasted until the secularisation of the bishopric in 1803.
simp_chinese: 阿豪斯围绕阿河畔的一处贵族宅邸发展起来，该宅邸约于1030年已有记载。阿豪斯领主在十二世纪建造城堡，在强大邻邦之间拥有一块小型威斯特伐利亚领地。因效忠关系发生争端，明斯特主教亲王于1177年摧毁了阿豪斯和迪彭海姆两座城堡，但领主家族仍保有领地。城堡旁的聚落于1389年获得征收消费税的特权，两年后获得城市权利。1406年，奥托四世·冯霍亚主教购得阿豪斯领地，将其并入明斯特。阿豪斯成为行政区中心，管辖明斯特兰西部众多教区；这一安排一直延续到1803年主教领世俗化。

english: Ahé is a Kawahiva word for a person, used among peoples whose related Tupi-Guarani languages are spoken in the southwestern Amazon. Kawahiva communities inhabit forest country around the Madeira and its tributaries. Their oral histories tell of a time when groups separated, while their languages preserve connections among communities spread across the wide region between the Madeira and Tapajós basins.
simp_chinese: 阿赫在卡瓦希瓦语中意为“人”。使用相关图皮－瓜拉尼语言的卡瓦希瓦诸民族生活在亚马孙西南部，社区分布于马德拉河及其支流周围的森林地带。他们的口述历史讲述了各群体分离的时代，而语言则保留着分布在马德拉与塔帕若斯流域之间的社区彼此相连的痕迹。

english:
Ahel lies in southern Fars, east of Eshkanan and at the foot of the Kol-e Salar and Buchir heights. The Mehran River runs north of the town, while hot, dry summers alternate with mild winters and brief rain. Date palms, grain and orchard plots cluster around wells and seasonal water. The surrounding ridges and open basin made routes toward Lamerd, Lar and the Persian Gulf coast important for exchange.

The older name Nehel survives in local speech. Residents speak the Aheli form of Achomi, a southwestern Iranian language related to Lari and preserved across parts of Fars and the coastal Gulf region. Traditional stories connect the settlement with remains more than a thousand years old. Stone walls, old cisterns and ruined buildings around the town mark earlier phases of occupation, while oral histories preserve the names of families and quarters.

Ahel served the villages of a dry district rather than a major caravan terminus. Farmers raised dates and cereals, herders used the surrounding slopes, and craftsmen supplied tools and household goods. Market days and religious festivals brought these scattered communities together. The settlement’s compact core and broad rural hinterland reflect a long adjustment to scarce water and strong seasonal heat.
simp_chinese:
阿赫尔位于法尔斯南部，在埃什卡南以东，背靠科拉萨拉尔与布奇尔高地。梅赫兰河从城镇北面流过，夏季炎热干燥，冬季温和而降雨短暂。枣椰、谷物和果园集中在水井与季节水源周围。周围山脊和开阔盆地，使通往拉梅尔德、拉尔以及波斯湾海岸的道路具有交换意义。

奈赫尔这一旧名仍保存在地方口语中。居民使用阿赫尔方言，它属于与拉里语相近的西南伊朗语，散布在法尔斯及波斯湾沿岸部分地区。地方传说把聚落同千余年前的遗迹联系起来。城周的石墙、旧蓄水池和残垣标示更早的居住阶段，口述历史则保留家族与街区的名称。

阿赫尔服务的是干旱地区的诸多村庄，而非大型商队终点。农民种植枣椰和谷物，牧民利用周围坡地，工匠制造工具和家庭用品。集市日与宗教节庆把分散社群聚到一起。紧凑的城镇核心和宽广乡郊，体现当地对稀少水源和强烈季节高温的长期适应。

english:
Aheri was the centre of an extensive estate in the forested country southeast of Chanda. Its chiefs were related to the Gond royal family and held lands rich in teak and shisham. The estate’s early history is tied to the rulers of Chanda, who depended on local chiefs to govern the wooded districts beyond their capital.

Koksha, who held Aheri from 1703 to 1769, received his grant from the Gond king Ram Shah on condition that he expel rebellious chiefs from Surjagarh. After several years of warfare he succeeded and later fought for the last Gond ruler against the Marathas. His successor supported the Bhonsle chief Mudhoji in 1773. In 1818 the Aheri chief again backed the Bhonsle cause, garrisoning Chanda against the British.
simp_chinese:
阿赫里是一片广阔领地的中心，位于钱达东南方的森林地区。当地首领与贡德王室有亲属关系，所掌土地盛产柚木和印度紫檀。领地早期历史与钱达统治者密切相连；国王依靠地方首领管理首都以外的林区。

1703年至1769年掌管阿赫里的科克沙，从贡德国王拉姆沙阿处获得领地，条件是将叛乱首领逐出苏尔贾加尔。经过数年战争，他最终完成任务，后来又为最后的贡德统治者抵抗马拉塔人。其继承者于1773年支持本斯勒首领穆多吉。1818年阿赫里首领再次支持本斯勒一方，在钱达驻军抵抗英国人。

english:
Aheyya Fagg is a mountain pass in the highlands of Amhara in northern Ethiopia. The surrounding country belongs to the Ethiopian plateau, where steep escarpments, cultivated uplands and seasonal streams separate the central political heartland from routes toward the Red Sea, the Awash basin and the southern plains. Control of the pass therefore meant control over movement between distinct regions.

During the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, Aheyya Fagg became part of a defended system of routes, fortified places and royal marches. Local strongholds guarded approaches to the pass, while armies, monks, merchants and pilgrims used the corridor when safer lowland roads were blocked. Ethiopian rulers granted lands and privileges to communities responsible for protecting the route, tying local authority to the wider kingdom.

Its name appears in historical geography as a place where mountain terrain and political power met. The pass linked Amhara with regions beyond the escarpment, but its daily importance lay in smaller traffic: grain, livestock, salt, cloth and metal goods moving between highland markets and lowland suppliers. Fortifications made the route visible to states, while farmers and herders made it workable.
simp_chinese:
阿赫亚法格是埃塞俄比亚北部阿姆哈拉高地的一处山口。周围属于埃塞俄比亚高原，陡峭断崖、耕作高地与季节性河流把中央政治核心同通往红海、阿瓦什盆地和南部平原的道路隔开。控制山口，也就控制了不同地区之间的往来。

十五世纪和十六世纪，阿赫亚法格进入由路线、设防地点和皇家行军共同组成的防御体系。地方堡垒守卫通道入口，军队、修士、商人和朝圣者在低地道路不安全时经此通行。埃塞俄比亚统治者向负责保护道路的社群授予土地和特权，把地方权威同更大的王国联系起来。

历史地理记载把这里视为山地与政治权力交会之处。山口连接阿姆哈拉与断崖以外地区，日常交通则由较小规模的粮食、牲畜、盐、布匹和金属器物流组成，在高地市场与低地供应者之间往返。堡垒让国家看见这条道路，农民和牧民则使它真正能够通行。

english:
Kanatakon belongs to the Saint Lawrence country that the British organised as Lower Canada. The colonial region followed the lower Saint Lawrence toward the Gulf and formed the northern part of the St. Lawrence Valley, through which goods, settlers and officials could travel between the Great Lakes interior and the Atlantic. After the British conquest of New France, the area became part of British North America.

The Constitutional Act of 1791 then divided the old Province of Quebec, placing Lower Canada around the lower river and Upper Canada farther upstream. Lower Canada retained a Francophone majority while acquiring British representative institutions and a governor answerable to London. That combination produced recurring conflict over taxation, patronage, land and the authority of the elected assembly. The Saint Lawrence was central to the colony's economy, connecting Quebec City, Montreal and the rural seigneurial settlements along its banks.

Kanatakon therefore lies within a river corridor whose towns, farms and nations were drawn into changing imperial arrangements.
simp_chinese:
卡纳塔孔属于圣劳伦斯河地区，英国后来把这里组织为下加拿大。殖民地沿圣劳伦斯河下游伸向海湾，构成圣劳伦斯谷地北部；货物、移民与官员可通过这条水道往来于五大湖内陆和大西洋之间。英国征服新法兰西后，当地成为英属北美的一部分。

1791年《宪法法案》把旧魁北克省一分为二，下加拿大位于河流下游，上加拿大则在上游。下加拿大保留法语人口多数，同时建立英国式代议机构和向伦敦负责的总督。这种组合使税收、官职任命、土地与民选议会权限不断引发冲突。

圣劳伦斯河是殖民地经济命脉，把魁北克城、蒙特利尔以及沿岸领主制农村连接起来。卡纳塔孔因此处在一条河流走廊之中，沿岸城镇、农田与各个原住民族都被卷入不断变动的帝国安排。

english:
Ahkwesahsne is a Mohawk community on the Saint Lawrence River, near the mouths of the Saint Regis and Raquette rivers. French missionaries called the settlement Saint Regis, but the Mohawk name was already in use in the eighteenth century. Its position on the river placed it along the waterway between the Great Lakes and the settlements of New France.

In the 1750s Mohawk families moved upriver from Kahnawake, and French Jesuits established a mission at the site. Refugees from the Oswegatchie mission also settled here after the upheavals of war. The boundary drawn between British territory and the United States after the American Revolution crossed the community's lands. In 1796 a treaty involving the Seven Nations of Canada reserved a much smaller tract for the people of Saint Regis.
simp_chinese:
阿克韦萨斯内是圣劳伦斯河畔的莫霍克人社群，靠近圣雷吉斯河与拉奎特河的河口。法国传教士称这里为圣雷吉斯，但莫霍克名称在十八世纪便已使用。聚落位于连接五大湖和新法兰西各地的水路之上。

十八世纪五十年代，莫霍克家庭从卡纳瓦克沿河迁来，法国耶稣会士在此设立传教站。战争动荡之后，来自奥斯威加奇传教站的难民也在此定居。美国革命后划定的英属领地与美国边界穿过社群的土地。1796年，涉及加拿大七族的一项条约为圣雷吉斯居民保留了一块小得多的土地。

english:
Ahlat lies on the northwestern shore of Lake Van in eastern Anatolia, on an elevated plateau about 1,650 meters above sea level. Small streams descend from the surrounding highlands toward the lake. To the south stretches Lake Van, formerly called the Lake of Khlat after the town, while Mount Nemrut and Mount Süphan mark the horizons to the west. The setting supplied water, fish, pasture, and a protected route along the lake, but the site required strong fortifications because the plains around it formed a corridor between Armenia, Mesopotamia, and central Anatolia.

Known in Armenian as Khlat or Chliat, the settlement belonged first to the noble house of Bznuni and later passed among Armenian princes, Arab governors, and Kurdish emirs. By the tenth and eleventh centuries it had grown into one of the largest cities of Armenia. It possessed a massive wall with three gates and served as the biggest port on Lake Van. Merchants moving between Archesh and Baghesh and travelers from the Urmia region used its markets. Arab, Persian, and Armenian communities lived together, and writers praised the city’s prosperity and crafts.

In 1071 Sultan Alp Arslan took Ahlat after the Battle of Manzikert. The Seljuks entrusted it to the Turkmen commander Sökmen el-Kutbi, whose successors were called the Shah-Armens or Ahlat-shahs and made the city their capital. Later Ahlat became a disputed frontier among the Ayyubids, Georgia, the Sultanate of Rum, Khwarazmian armies, and the Mongols. Its walls and commerce sustained it, but the shifting wars gradually eroded its regional importance.

During the Ottoman-Persian conflicts of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, Ahlat was repeatedly contested because it lay on the frontier of empires. The town declined, yet it retained important Armenian churches, a mosque, and fragments of its old city. The monumental cemetery outside the walls preserves towers of carved stone from the Ahlatshah period. These tombstones, together with the fortress and lakeshore remains, make Ahlat a compact record of Armenian, Islamic, Seljuk, Kurdish, and Ottoman histories on the Lake Van frontier. Nasir Khusraw visited in the eleventh century and noted that Arabic, Persian, and Armenian were spoken. Its market and craft production drew people from the Armenian highlands, the Lake Van basin, and the routes toward Mesopotamia. This multilingual prosperity explains why many chroniclers described Ahlat as a boundary city that was nevertheless wealthy.
simp_chinese:
阿赫拉特位于东安纳托利亚凡湖西北岸，坐落在海拔约1650米的高原上。多条小河从周边高地流向湖面，南方是曾因城市而被称为“赫拉特湖”的凡湖，西方地平线上可见内姆鲁特山和苏潘山。湖区提供饮水、鱼类、牧场和沿岸通道，但周围平原又是亚美尼亚、美索不达米亚和安纳托利亚中部之间的走廊，因此城镇必须依赖坚固防御。

城市在亚美尼亚语中称 Khlat 或 Chliat，最初属于布兹努尼贵族家族，后来在亚美尼亚王公、阿拉伯总督和库尔德埃米尔之间易手。到十世纪和十一世纪，阿赫拉特已发展为亚美尼亚最大城市之一，拥有三座城门的厚重城墙和凡湖最重要港口。往返阿尔切什、巴格什及乌尔米耶地区的商人都在此贸易。阿拉伯人、波斯人和亚美尼亚人共同生活，编年史家称赞城市财富与工艺。

1071年曼齐刻尔特战役后，阿尔普·阿尔斯兰苏丹取得阿赫拉特。塞尔柱人把城市交给土库曼将领索克曼·库特比，其继承者被称为沙阿-亚美尼亚或阿赫拉特沙，并把这里作为都城。此后阿尤布王朝、格鲁吉亚、罗姆苏丹国、花剌子模和蒙古军队又反复争夺城市。城墙和商业维持其地位，持续战争却逐渐削弱区域作用。

十六、十七世纪奥斯曼与波斯战争中，阿赫拉特因处在帝国边境而屡遭争夺。城市衰退，却仍保留亚美尼亚教堂、清真寺与旧城遗迹。城外大型墓地保存着阿赫拉特沙时期的石碑塔群；这些雕刻墓石同堡垒与湖岸遗址共同记录了凡湖边疆上亚美尼亚、伊斯兰、塞尔柱、库尔德和奥斯曼历史的层层叠加。十一世纪旅行家纳西尔·胡斯劳到访时记载当地通行阿拉伯语、波斯语和亚美尼亚语。集市与手工业吸引亚美尼亚高原、凡湖盆地和通往美索不达米亚的商旅。这种多语言繁荣解释了编年史为何把阿赫拉特同时描述为边界城市和富庶都会。凡湖不仅提供渔业和航道，也把城市同湖岸其他聚落连接起来。港口贸易、农业腹地、亚美尼亚教会网络与穆斯林商路同时存在，使阿赫拉特能够跨越王朝更替继续繁荣；当战争长期化，这些联系又成为各方反复争夺的目标。

english: Ahmad Khan lies among the Kirthar hills near Ranikot Fort in Sindh. Long stone walls follow the ridges around a wide valley, with the smaller forts of Mirikot and Shergarh within the enclosure. The Sann gate stands on the eastern side, where a seasonal torrent passes through. Talpur rulers rebuilt parts of the fortifications in the early nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 艾哈迈德汗位于信德基尔塔尔丘陵中，靠近拉尼科特堡。漫长的石墙沿山脊围住宽阔谷地，墙内还有米里科特和谢尔加尔两座较小堡垒。东侧的桑恩门有季节性溪流经过；十九世纪初，塔尔普尔统治者重建了部分防御设施。

english:
Ahmednagar lies in the rain shadow of the Western Ghats, on a dry upland of black soil, scattered hills and irrigated fields beside the Sina River. Ahmad Nizam Shah I founded the city in 1494 on the site of the older settlement of Bhingar, after a victory over a larger Bahmani force. Contemporary chroniclers describe a surveyed capital with palaces, squares, shops and gardens, and Firishta claimed that within two years it rivalled Baghdad and Cairo.

Ahmednagar was the seat of the Nizam Shahi dynasty, one of the five Deccan sultanates that split from the Bahmanis. Hussain Nizam Shah I completed the stone fort in 1559, and in 1565 he joined the other sultans against Vijayanagara at Talikota. In 1595 the regent Chand Bibi, queen of the dynasty, led the defence of the fort against a Mughal army under Prince Murad, and Akbar's men took the fort only in 1600. The regent Malik Ambar then kept the sultanate alive from Khadki until the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan conquered the city in 1636.

Aurangzeb spent the last years of his reign campaigning in the Deccan and died at Ahmednagar in 1707. The Peshwa gained the city from the Nizam of Hyderabad in 1759, and in 1795, after the Battle of Kharda, he ceded it to Daulat Rao Sindhia. A British force under Arthur Wellesley besieged and captured Ahmednagar in 1803, and it passed to the British for good in 1817.
simp_chinese:
艾哈迈德讷格尔位于西高止山的雨影区，在锡纳河畔一片干燥的高地上，有黑土、零散的丘陵和灌溉田地。艾哈迈德·尼扎姆·沙阿一世于1494年在更古老的聚落宾加尔旧址上建城，那是他战胜了兵力更多的巴赫曼尼军队之后。同时代的编年史家描述这是一座经过测绘的都城，有宫殿、广场、店铺和花园，费里什塔称它在两年之内就能与巴格达和开罗媲美。

艾哈迈德讷格尔是尼扎姆沙希王朝的所在地，该王朝是从巴赫曼尼分裂出来的德干五个素丹国之一。侯赛因·尼扎姆·沙阿一世在1559年建成石头堡垒，1565年联合其他素丹在塔利科塔对抗毗奢耶那伽罗。1595年，摄政的王后尚德·比比领导守军抵御穆拉德王子率领的莫卧儿军队，阿克巴的军队直到1600年才攻下堡垒。摄政马利克·安巴尔此后从卡德基让素丹国延续下去，直到莫卧儿皇帝沙贾汗1636年征服此城。

奥朗则布统治的最后几年在德干征战，1707年死于艾哈迈德讷格尔。1759年，佩什瓦从海得拉巴尼扎姆手中取得此城，1795年卡尔达战役后又把它割让给道拉特·拉奥·辛迪亚。亚瑟·韦尔斯利率领的英军于1803年围攻并攻占艾哈迈德讷格尔，1817年它最终归于英国。

english: Ahná:wate is the Raquette River, which flows from the lakes and forests of the Adirondack Mountains to the Saint Lawrence. Its waters form part of a network of canoe routes through the uplands, joined to other waterways by short carrying places. Near its mouth lies Ahkwesáhsne, a Mohawk community where French Jesuits established a mission in the 1750s. The river links the wooded interior with the great waterway along which that community grew.
simp_chinese: 阿纳瓦特即拉奎特河，源自阿迪朗达克山区的湖泊和森林，流向圣劳伦斯河。河水构成穿越高地的独木舟水路网的一部分，经短暂的陆路搬运便能接入其他水道。河口附近是莫霍克人社群阿克韦萨斯内，法国耶稣会士于十八世纪五十年代在那里建立传教站。这条河将森林内陆与社群赖以发展的圣劳伦斯水道连接起来。

english:
Ahobalam is a sacred place among the hills and gorges of the Eastern Ghats, devoted to Narasimha, the lion-headed form of Vishnu. Lower Ahobilam has a temple complex beside the village; farther east, the shrines of Upper Ahobilam stand in a steep gorge. The Tamil poet-saint Thirumangai Alvar praised the place in the ninth century, and it became one of the revered Divya Desams.

The Kakatiya and Reddi dynasties endowed its shrines, followed by the rulers of the Vijayanagara kingdom. Krishnadevaraya visited and patronised them in the sixteenth century, and the monastic institution of the Ahobila Matha also arose here. In 1579 Murahari Rao, a commander of the Golconda Sultanate, raided the temple and carried its jewelled image to the sultan.
simp_chinese:
阿赫巴拉姆是东高止山脉丘陵与峡谷间的圣地，供奉毗湿奴的狮首化身那罗辛诃。下阿霍比拉姆的村庄旁有神庙群，向东的上阿霍比拉姆则有圣祠坐落在陡峭峡谷中。九世纪泰米尔诗人圣者蒂鲁芒盖·阿尔瓦赞颂此地，它后来被列为受人尊崇的毗湿奴圣地之一。

卡卡提亚和雷迪王朝曾向圣祠捐赠，毗奢耶那伽罗的统治者后来也加以赞助。十六世纪，克里希纳德瓦拉亚亲临礼拜；阿霍比拉修院也在此兴起。1579年，戈尔康达将领穆拉哈里·拉奥袭掠神庙，将镶宝石的神像献给苏丹。

english:
Ahome lies on the coastal plain of northern Sinaloa near the Gulf of California, in the broad and fertile Fuerte valley. Rivers descending from the Sierra Madre supplied water for maize, beans and other crops, while coastal lagoons and the gulf provided fish, salt and routes toward the north. The lowland stood between the inland valleys and the sea.

The region was home to Cahita-speaking peoples before Spanish expeditions entered northwestern New Spain. Jesuit missionaries founded Mission Santa María Ahome in 1605, gathering Indigenous households around a church and cultivating land nearby. The mission became a base for religious instruction, agriculture and Spanish authority along a frontier where settlers, soldiers and Indigenous communities depended on one another.

Ahome grew as an agricultural settlement within the colonial province of Sinaloa. Wheat, maize, cattle and coastal products supported local markets, and the nearby port approaches linked the Fuerte valley with Pacific shipping. Landholding changed as Spanish and later Mexican ranching families expanded into the valley, but the rivers and coastal marshes remained the basis of settlement. The old community's identity centred on the mission, irrigated fields and the route from the interior to the Gulf of California.
simp_chinese:
阿霍梅位于墨西哥锡那罗亚州北部的太平洋沿岸平原，处在加利福尼亚湾入口和富饶的富尔特河谷。马德雷山脉流下的河水灌溉玉米、豆类等作物，沿海潟湖与海湾提供鱼、盐以及向北的道路。低地夹在山谷和海洋之间。

西班牙远征者进入新西班牙西北部以前，卡希塔语族群生活在这里。一六〇五年，耶稣会士建立圣玛丽亚阿霍梅传教站，把原住民家庭聚集到教堂和耕地周围。传教站成为宗教教育、农业和西班牙权威的据点，移民、士兵与原住民社群的生计彼此依赖。

阿霍梅作为农业聚落在殖民时期锡那罗亚省逐渐成长。小麦、玉米、牲畜与沿海物产供应地方市场，附近的港口通道把富尔特谷同太平洋航运相连。土地占有随着西班牙及后来的牧场家庭扩张而变化，但河流与海岸湿地仍是聚落基础。旧阿霍梅的身份集中于传教站、灌溉农田以及内陆通往加利福尼亚湾的道路。

english: Ahouenro lies south of Lake Ontario, in the country drained by Oak Orchard Creek. Rising near the marshes to the south, the creek winds north through a succession of rapids and falls before reaching the lake. Smaller streams, including Otter Creek and Marsh Creek, join its lower course. This waterway carries the drainage of a broad tract between the inland wetlands and the southern shore of Ontario.
simp_chinese: 阿霍恩罗位于安大略湖南岸内陆，处于橡园溪流域。溪流发源于南方湿地附近，蜿蜒北行，经过一连串急流与瀑布后注入湖中。水獭溪、沼泽溪等较小河流在下游汇入。橡园溪汇集了内陆湿地与安大略湖南岸之间广大地区的水流。

english:
Ahrweiler lies in the Ahr valley on the left bank of the Rhine, among the hills of the Ahrgebirge. The small river joins the Rhine after passing vineyards, meadows and wooded slopes. Sheltered valley sides support early-ripening grapes, while upland woods supply timber, game and pasture. Roads follow the river between riverside settlements and the Eifel uplands.

An estate register of Prüm Abbey dated 893 names the place and lists a manor, twenty-four farmsteads, farmland and seventy-six acres of vineyards. The record shows a fully established wine community long before later towns developed. Roman remains from the first to third centuries, including a country villa, carry settlement farther back. During the Middle Ages the counts of Neuenahr ruled the district.

The Gasthaus Sanct Peter was founded in 1246, serving travelers beside the vineyards, and a parish church was mentioned in records between 1204 and 1225. Winegrowers, millers and craftsmen supplied local and Rhine markets. Ahrweiler’s identity joins Roman estate life, medieval noble rule and a vineyard landscape that remained the foundation of the valley economy. Valley roads carried wine and fruit.
simp_chinese:
阿尔魏勒位于莱茵河左岸的阿尔河谷，处在艾费尔山前丘陵间。小河穿过葡萄园、草甸和林坡后汇入莱茵河。避风谷坡适合早熟葡萄，高地森林提供木材、猎物与牧场。道路沿河连接各处河畔聚落与艾费尔高地。

八九三年普鲁姆修院的产业登记提到当地，列有庄园、二十四座农舍、耕地和七十六英亩葡萄园。记录显示早在后世城镇发展以前，这里已有成熟的葡萄酒社群。一至三世纪的罗马遗存，包括乡间别墅，把定居史推得更远。中世纪时，诺伊纳尔伯爵统治地区。

圣彼得旅舍一二四六年建立，在葡萄园旁接待旅人，堂区教堂则在1204至1225年的文献中出现。葡萄农、磨坊主和工匠供应地方及莱茵市场。阿尔魏勒的身份把罗马庄园、中世纪贵族统治和长期作为谷地经济基础的葡萄园景观结合起来。谷地道路运送葡萄酒和水果。

english: Ahsenisiipi lies near the Mississippi north of the Rock River's mouth. On the Rock stood Saukenuk, a large Sauk village where the leader Black Hawk was born. His determination to return to the homeland occupied by American settlers helped lead to the Black Hawk War of 1832. The village occupied a tongue of land between the Rock and the Mississippi, below the Rock River's rapids.
simp_chinese: 阿赫塞尼西皮位于密西西比河畔，靠近罗克河口以北。罗克河上曾有大型索克村落索肯纳克，领袖黑鹰出生于此。他决心返回已被美国移民占据的故土，成为1832年黑鹰战争的起因之一。村落位于罗克河急流下方、罗克河与密西西比河之间伸出的陆地上。

english: Lake Atna was a great ice-dammed lake that once occupied much of the Copper River Basin. Glaciers blocked the river’s passage through the mountains, allowing water to spread across the lowlands; as the ice retreated, the lake drained toward the Gulf of Alaska. By the period of the Ahtna people’s settlements along the Copper River, the ancient lake had long disappeared, leaving sediments and traces of old shorelines in the basin. Ahtna oral traditions also tell of a large lake in this country.
simp_chinese: 阿特纳湖曾是一座被冰川阻挡形成的大湖，覆盖铜河盆地的广大地区。冰川封住河流穿越山地的通道，使水漫过低地；冰川退缩后，湖水流向阿拉斯加湾。阿特纳人在铜河沿岸建立聚落时，这座古湖早已消失，盆地中留下湖底沉积物和古岸线的痕迹。阿特纳人的口传故事也讲述过这片土地上曾有一座大湖。

english:
Ahtopol occupies a headland on the southern Bulgarian coast, with Strandzha Nature Park behind it and the Turkish frontier close at hand. The site was inhabited from the Neolithic period and contained a Thracian settlement before Greek colonization around 440–430 BCE. Roman rule brought the name Peronticus, while the Byzantine commander Agathon later rebuilt the town and may have supplied the name Agathopolis. Alternative accounts place that Greek name as early as 323 BCE, and an older name, Aulaiouteichos, also survived in the record.

The Arabic geographer al-Idrisi knew it as a notable and famous center. During the Middle Ages the town repeatedly passed between Byzantine and Bulgarian rulers. Byzantine, Italian and other ships entered its harbor, making trade part of everyday life. Ottoman troops raided the region at the end of the fourteenth century and called the place Ahtenbolu, although the town held out until 1453.

A tax register from 1498 counted 158 Christian families, most with Greek names and others evidently Slavic. In the nineteenth century Ahtopol remained a fishery and shipping center whose residents sailed across the Black Sea and Mediterranean, and vineyards contributed to its prosperity. Fortress walls, a monastery, church and carved fountain preserve fragments of this long coastal story.
simp_chinese:
阿赫托波尔占据保加利亚南部黑海海岸的一处岬角，身后是斯特兰贾自然公园，附近就是土耳其边界。当地从新石器时代便有人类活动，曾有一处色雷斯聚落，约在公元前440至前430年又经历希腊殖民。罗马统治时期名为佩龙提库斯；拜占庭统帅阿加同后来重建城镇，阿加托波利斯这个名称可能由此而来。另有说法认为该希腊地名早在公元前323年已经存在，更古老的名称奥莱乌泰科斯也留在文献中。

阿拉伯地理学家伊德里西曾把这里记作著名而显眼的中心。中世纪时，城镇多次在拜占庭和保加利亚统治者之间易手。来自拜占庭、意大利及其他港口的船舶驶入港湾，使贸易成为日常生活的一部分。十四世纪末，奥斯曼军队侵入附近地区，并以阿赫滕博卢称呼此地，但城镇直到1453年才最终归入奥斯曼统治。

1498年的税册记录了158个基督徒家庭，其中多数使用希腊姓名，也有人显然使用斯拉夫姓名。到十九世纪，阿赫托波尔仍是渔业与海运中心，居民驾船往来于黑海和地中海，葡萄种植也带来收益。堡垒、修道院、教堂和雕有人像的泉池，保存了这段漫长海岸历史的不同片段。

english:
Ahuacatlán lies in southeastern Nayarit, among the valleys and ridges that connect the Pacific slope with the highlands of western Mexico. Its Nahuatl name combines ahua, “avocado,” with tlan, “place,” and is commonly understood as “where avocados abound.” The surrounding land supports maize, beans, sugarcane and fruit, while springs and seasonal streams enabled dense settlement near the town.

The district contains some of the region’s richest assemblages of shaft-tomb culture, whose underground chambers were used from roughly 200 BCE to 600 CE. A tomb at Las Cebollas held two human skeletons, more than eighty ceramic vessels, figurines, flutes, shell ornaments and a model. These objects show exchange with neighboring regions and elaborate rituals for the dead. Later, Aztatlán traditions developed into the small señorío of Ahuacatlán, which controlled several subject settlements and spoke a local Chocho-Popoloca-related speech.

Nahua migrants founded a town associated with their journey toward central Anáhuac. The settlement already served as an important passage and exchange point when Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán arrived in 1529. Franciscans established a convent in 1550, adding evangelization, crafts and schooling to the settlement. The Camino Real linking Guadalajara with San Blas later crossed the town, sustaining muleteers, merchants and farmers around its central plaza.
simp_chinese:
阿瓦卡特兰位于纳亚里特东南部，处在连接太平洋坡地与墨西哥西部高地的谷地和山脊之间。纳瓦特尔语地名由“阿瓦”（牛油果）与“特兰”（地方）组成，通常解作“牛油果丰盛之地”。周围土地适合玉米、豆类、甘蔗和水果，泉水与季节溪流使城镇附近能够形成密集聚落。

这一地区保存着丰富的竖井墓文化遗存，地下墓室约在公元前二百年至公元六百年间使用。拉斯塞博利亚斯的一座墓中出土两具人骨、八十余件陶器、陶偶、笛子、贝饰和模型，显示同邻近地区的交换以及对死者的复杂礼仪。后来，阿兹特兰传统发展为小而有力的阿瓦卡特兰领地，控制若干从属聚落，使用一种与乔乔—波波洛卡语相关的本地语言。

纳瓦人迁徙途中留下部分成员，建立了城镇。一五二九年努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼到达时，这里已是重要通道和交换点。方济各会于一五五〇年建立修院，为聚落增加传教、手工技艺与教育。连接瓜达拉哈拉和圣布拉斯港的王家大道后来穿过镇中心，使赶骡人、商人和农民聚集于广场周边。

english:
Ahuilizapan, later known as Orizaba, stands in a valley of the eastern Mexican highlands beneath the great volcanic peak that bears its name. It was already an important settlement when the Spanish arrived. Its position between the Gulf coast and the interior placed it on a route across the steep eastern slopes.

The Mexica expansion under Moctezuma I brought Ahuilizapan and other eastern lordships under imperial control. Orizaba continued to prosper in the colonial period and was granted the rank of villa in 1774. During the war for Mexican independence, José María Morelos captured it in 1812. After independence it became a city in 1830; the Cocolapan textile factory was established there in 1836. In 1821 Agustín de Iturbide stayed at Orizaba around the signing of the Treaty of Córdoba in the neighboring city.
simp_chinese:
阿维利萨潘后来称为奥里萨巴，位于墨西哥东部高地的山谷中，耸立的奥里萨巴火山俯瞰着这座城镇。西班牙人到来时，它已是一处重要聚落。这里地处墨西哥湾海岸与内陆之间，是穿越东部陡峭山坡的道路上的一站。

蒙特苏马一世统治期间，墨西加人的扩张使阿维利萨潘和其他东部领地落入帝国控制。殖民时期奥里萨巴继续发展，1774年获授城镇地位。墨西哥独立战争中，何塞·玛丽亚·莫雷洛斯于1812年攻占此地。独立后，奥里萨巴于1830年成为城市，科科拉潘纺织厂于1836年在此建立。1821年，阿古斯丁·德·伊图尔维德在邻近的科尔多瓦签订条约前后，曾在奥里萨巴停留。

english: Ahunui is a low coral atoll south of Hao in the Tuamotus, with a lagoon enclosed by reef. In 1826 Frederick William Beechey’s expedition visited the atoll and found castaways from Anaa, whose canoe had been carried far off course by storms.
simp_chinese: 阿胡努伊是土阿莫土群岛中豪岛以南的一座低矮珊瑚环礁，礁体围住潟湖。1826年，弗雷德里克·威廉·比奇的船队到访时发现来自阿纳阿的遇难者，他们的独木舟被风暴吹离航线很远。

english:
Ahurei lies in the Waikato region of New Zealand's North Island, a country of river valleys, rough hills and coasts facing two seas. The Waikato River runs north from Lake Taupō, while the Waihou, Piako, Awakino and Mōkau drain neighbouring landscapes. Natural harbours at Raglan, Aotea and Kāwhia cut into the western coast, where black volcanic sand meets the surf. Before any roads were made, rivers and waka carried people and goods across this country.

Ngāti Maniapoto and other Waikato Māori grew potatoes and kūmara and traded them with visiting ships along the coast. Waka linked settlements around the Waikato and Waipā rivers, and travellers carried small craft over the narrow portage between the Waikato and Manukau waters.
simp_chinese:
阿胡雷伊位于新西兰北岛的怀卡托地区，这里是河谷、起伏丘陵和面向两海的土地。怀卡托河从陶波湖向北流淌，怀霍河、皮亚科河、阿瓦基诺河与莫考河则排泄邻近地带的水流。拉格伦、奥蒂亚和卡维亚的天然港湾切入西岸，黑色火山砂与海浪相接。在修建道路之前，河流与独木舟承担着人员与货物的往来。

恩加蒂·马尼亚波托等怀卡托毛利人种植马铃薯与库马拉，并把这些食物卖给沿岸来访的船只。独木舟连接怀卡托河与怀帕河沿岸的聚落，人们还把小船拖过怀卡托河和曼努考水域之间的狭窄陆路。

english: Ahuya Yari lies beside the Caratasca Lagoon on the Caribbean coast of Honduras. Its Miskito name means “long beach” or “long sand,” recalling the low sandy shores of this lagoon country. Channels link the lagoon to the sea, while wetlands and forest stretch inland. The waters and waterways of the Mosquitia connect communities across a coast of beaches, lagoons and river mouths.
simp_chinese: 阿胡亚亚里位于洪都拉斯加勒比海岸的卡拉塔斯卡泻湖畔。其米斯基托语名称意为“长滩”或“长沙”，令人想起泻湖地区低平的沙岸。水道将泻湖与大海相连，湿地和森林向内陆延伸。莫斯基蒂亚的水域连接着分布在海滩、泻湖和河口之间的社区。

english: Ahvaz stands on the Karun River in the hot plain of Khuzestan, where the water breaks through a low ridge in a series of rapids. The city was an important centre of the medieval province, known for its sugar and the cultivated lands watered by the river. An ancient barrage and a great brick bridge once crossed the Karun, linking the districts on its banks. After the Mongol period the city declined, and authority in the region passed to the Musha'sha' and later the Safavids. The river nevertheless remained a valuable route through the plain. Its rapids interrupted navigation, obliging goods to be transferred between vessels travelling on the lower and upper reaches toward Shushtar.
simp_chinese: 阿瓦士坐落在胡齐斯坦炎热平原上的卡伦河畔，河流在此切穿低矮山脊，形成一连串急流。它曾是中古时期该地区的重要中心，以蔗糖和河水灌溉的耕地闻名。古代拦河坝与巨大的砖桥曾横跨卡伦河，连接两岸城区。蒙古时代之后城市衰落，地区权力转入穆沙沙王朝，后来又由萨法维王朝掌握。然而河流仍是穿越平原的重要通道。急流阻断航行，货物必须在下游船只与通往舒什塔尔的上游船只之间转运。

english: Ahwar lies on the southern Yemeni coast near the mouth of the wadi that bears its name. Wadi Ahwar is formed by the joining of Wadi Saba and Wadi Jahir, and spreads across a delta before reaching the Arabian Sea. Floods descend from the upper catchment in the rainy season, bringing water to deep soils on the coastal plain. The settlement stands among villages that use this seasonal flow to cultivate land in an otherwise dry landscape.
simp_chinese: 艾赫瓦尔位于也门南岸，靠近同名干河的河口。艾赫瓦尔干河由萨巴干河与贾希尔干河汇合而成，在抵达阿拉伯海之前流经三角洲。雨季洪水从上游流域而下，为沿海平原的深厚土壤带来水分。这座聚落与邻近村庄利用季节性水流，在周围干旱的土地上耕作。

english: Ahwendoe lies near Cap Tourmente, where the Laurentian hills meet the St. Lawrence estuary. Tidal marshes below the cape draw great flocks of snow geese. In 1626 Samuel de Champlain established a farm here, raising cattle and pigs to provision the small French settlement at Québec upstream.
simp_chinese: 阿文多位于图尔蒙特角附近，劳伦提亚山地在这里与圣劳伦斯河口相接。海角下的潮汐沼泽吸引大群雪雁。1626年，塞缪尔·德尚普兰在此建立农场，饲养牛和猪，为上游魁北克的小型法国聚落供应食物。

english: North of Farallón de Pájaros, the Pacific stretches beyond the northernmost island of the Mariana chain. The island is the summit of a volcano; to its southeast the submerged cone of Ahyi rises from deep water towards the surface. Together these peaks belong to the Mariana volcanic arc, west of the deep Mariana Trench.
simp_chinese: 在法拉隆德帕哈罗斯岛以北，太平洋延伸至马里亚纳群岛最北端岛屿之外。该岛是火山的山顶，岛屿东南方阿伊海底火山的锥体则从深水中向海面升起。这些山峰同属马里亚纳火山弧，位于深邃的马里亚纳海沟以西。

english:
ǀAi-ǀAis lies in the arid canyon country of southern Namibia, beside the Fish River at the foot of the Great Karas Mountains. The name means “hot as fire,” describing sulphurous springs that rise from deep beneath the riverbed at temperatures near 60°C. Water carries sulfur, chloride and fluoride, creating a permanent oasis amid dry hills and rocky gorges. Nama herders used the spring as a rare supply of water and pasture, moving through a landscape where wells and seasonal rains dictated the routes of people and livestock. Local tradition connects its discovery with a shepherd searching for lost sheep.

The spring lay on routes between the Orange River, southern Namibia and the Kalahari. Travelling families and herders gathered where water remained reliable, and the oasis became known beyond the immediate district. Its heat, minerals and isolation gave it a distinctive identity, but its importance rested on one permanent spring that determined where people could stop, rest and recover livestock. Fish River floods could suddenly transform the dry gorge, so travellers had to reach the spring while watching upstream weather. Water, heat and exposed terrain made the oasis both a refuge and a place of danger.
simp_chinese:
艾艾斯位于纳米比亚南部干旱峡谷地区，在鱼河岸边、大卡拉斯山脚。地名意为“热如火”，描述河床深处涌出的含硫温泉，水温接近六十摄氏度。泉水带有硫、氯化物和氟化物，在干燥丘陵与岩石峡谷间形成永久绿洲。纳马牧民把泉水作为罕见的水源和牧场，在井泉与季节降雨决定人畜路线的土地上移动。当地传说把泉眼的发现归于寻找走失羊群的牧人。

泉地位于奥兰治河、纳米比亚南部与卡拉哈里之间。迁徙家庭和牧民在水源可靠处汇集，绿洲的名声逐渐传向周围地区。高温、矿物质与偏远位置赋予它鲜明身份，真正的重要性却来自一个简单事实：在干旱边地，永久泉眼能够决定人们在哪里停留、休息和恢复牲畜。鱼河洪水可能突然改变干燥峡谷，旅人需留意上游天气。水源、高温与暴露的地形，使这片绿洲既是避难处，也是危险地。

english: Aichi lay on the border of Owari and Mikawa, where the Nōbi Plain meets Ise Bay and Mikawa Bay. Rivers crossing the plain repeatedly changed course and flooded, so settlements were placed on the higher natural levees. After taking the area in 1524, Matsudaira Kiyoyasu built Okazaki Castle, and his grandson Matsudaira Motoyasu, later Tokugawa Ieyasu, was born there in 1543. At Tokoname, on the shore of Ise Bay, potters made storage jars and wares in the tradition of the Six Ancient Kilns.
simp_chinese: 爱知位于尾张与三河交界处，浓尾平原在此连接伊势湾与三河湾。流经平原的河流反复改道泛滥，聚落因此建在较高的自然堤上。松平清康于1524年取得此地后修筑冈崎城，其孙松平元康，即后来的德川家康，于1543年在此城出生。伊势湾岸的常滑，窑工以“六古窑”之一的传统烧制贮藏用的大甕与各种器皿。

english: Aignay-le-Duc was a fortified town of the dukes of Burgundy, set among the uplands of the Châtillonnais. Its castle and walled enclosure marked the authority of its lords, while a thirteenth-century church served the community. Louis XI ordered the castle destroyed after the Burgundian wars, but the town's need for protection continued: in 1505 its inhabitants drew up rules for the defence of Aignay. Parts of the medieval enclosure remained after the castle itself had disappeared.
simp_chinese: 埃涅勒迪克是勃艮第公爵的一座设防城镇，位于沙蒂永地区的高地。城堡与围墙体现领主的权威，十三世纪的教堂则服务当地居民。勃艮第战争后，路易十一下令摧毁城堡，但城镇仍需防御：1505年，居民制定了保卫埃涅的规定。城堡消失之后，中世纪围墙的一部分仍然留存。

english:
Aigun, also written Aihui, was a historic town on the right bank of the Amur River in northern Manchuria, about thirty kilometers downstream from the site of present-day Heihe. The Chinese characters mean “bright jade,” but the name is a transliteration of a Manchu or Ducher place name rather than a description of local minerals. The Amur provided fish, drinking water, and the principal route through a forested and marshy frontier. Its broad channel also separated and connected the Manchu, Ducher, Daur, and Russian worlds whose settlements faced one another across the river.

The town’s predecessor belonged to the Ducher people and stood on the northeastern bank, now on the Russian side. Russian explorer Yerofey Khabarov recorded it as Aytyun in 1652. Archaeology suggests the site had been occupied since about the end of the first or beginning of the second millennium CE. During the Yongle era the Ming had also maintained a fort at Aigun for roughly twenty years. In the 1650s the Qing evacuated many Duchers toward the Sungari and Hurka, destabilizing the existing settlement pattern.

After Qing forces captured Albazin in 1685 or 1686, Aigun was moved to the southwestern bank, near the village of the Daurian chief Tolga. The new town became an important headquarters for the Manchu river fleet and frontier administration. From 1683 it served as the seat of the military governor of Heilongjiang, although the provincial capital soon moved first to Nenjiang in 1690 and later to Qiqihar. Aigun remained the seat of a deputy lieutenant-general responsible for a large section of the Amur valley.

Jesuit cartographers visited around 1709 and found a well-defended town surrounded by fertile riverside villages and food supplies. Its fleet controlled movement on the Amur and supported Qing influence over communities that paid tribute or traded along the river. The river was more than a boundary: its islands, channels, and tributaries supported fishing, transport, and tribute collection. Aigun’s survival depended on the Qing state’s ability to maintain a fleet and supply its frontier posts, while local Ducher and Daur communities supplied knowledge of the river and surrounding forests.
simp_chinese:
瑷珲位于满洲北部黑龙江右岸，在今黑河市所在地下游约三十公里。中文写作“瑷珲”并含有“美玉”的字面感觉，但它实际是满语或杜切尔语地名的音译，并非形容当地矿物。黑龙江提供鱼类、饮水与穿越森林沼泽边疆的主要航路，宽阔河道同时分隔并连接满人、杜切尔人、达斡尔人与俄国人的定居世界。

瑷珲的前身是杜切尔人在江东北岸（今属俄罗斯一侧）建立的城镇。俄国探险者哈巴罗夫在1652年记录为 Aytyun。考古研究认为遗址约从公元一千纪末或二千纪初便有人居住。明朝永乐年间也曾在瑷珲维持一座约二十年的堡垒。1650年代，清朝把大批杜切尔人迁往松花江和呼尔哈河方向，原有的人口与聚落格局因此改变。

清军于1685年或1686年攻占阿尔巴津后，把瑷珲迁到黑龙江西南岸，位置接近达斡尔首领托尔加旧村。新城成为满洲江防舰队和边疆行政的重要基地。1683年起，瑷珲担任黑龙江将军驻地，但省会随后在1690年迁往嫩江，后来又迁到齐齐哈尔。瑷珲仍是负责黑龙江流域大片地区的副都统驻地。

约1709年，耶稣会制图人员访问当地，看到防御坚固的城镇、周围肥沃的沿江村落和充足的粮食供应。瑷珲水师控制江面航行，维护清朝对沿江纳贡和贸易社群的影响。黑龙江不只是一条边界，岛屿、支流和汊道还支持渔业、运输和纳贡管理。瑷珲能否维持地位，取决于清朝能否保持江防舰队与边疆补给，也依赖杜切尔和达斡尔社群对河道、森林和季节变化的熟悉。

english:
Aikana refers to the homeland of the Aikanã, an Indigenous people of the Guaporé basin in western Rondônia, Brazil. Their territory lies in the moist Amazonian lowlands, where rivers and tributaries cut through forest and connect small clearings across a broad borderland. Houses and gardens stood along these waterways, while hunting, fishing and gathering followed the seasonal movement of food supplies. Forest supplied timber, fibres, medicines, food and materials for tools. Kinship linked scattered clearings without creating fixed borders.

The Aikanã are also known by names such as Massacá, Tubarão, Huari and Kasupá. Their language has no established relation to a larger family, while the Kwaza and Latundê remain distinct neighbouring peoples. Oral tradition centres on Kiantô, a giant rainbow serpent who rules the waters, tying communities to rivers, marshes and their animal life. Before written colonial records, family groups maintained detailed knowledge of forest trails and river crossings, reading flooded ground, hidden portages and the safest seasonal approaches. These routes joined fishing grounds with gardens and camps without passing through a single centre.

Seasonal camps brought households together where fish, game and ripening forest fruit were abundant. Gardens moved as soil and drainage required, while canoe routes joined the Guaporé and its tributaries with neighbouring peoples. Exchange carried food, fibres, tools and ceremonial knowledge without erasing separate languages and territories. Aikana therefore preserves a dispersed world of river villages, kinship and practical knowledge rather than a single permanent settlement.
simp_chinese:
艾卡纳指巴西朗多尼亚西部瓜波雷河流域的艾卡纳人故土。领地处于湿润的亚马孙低地，河流和支流穿过森林，把散布的空地连接在广阔边疆上。住宅与园地沿水道分布，狩猎、捕鱼和采集随资源季节变化而展开。森林提供木材、纤维、药材、食物和制造日用工具的原料，亲属关系把分散空地联系起来，却没有形成固定边界。

艾卡纳人还有马萨卡、图巴朗、瓦里和卡苏帕等名称。其语言与任何更大语系的关系都未确立，夸扎人与拉通德人则是不同的邻近民族。口传传统围绕掌管水域的巨型彩虹蛇基安托展开，把社群同河流、沼泽和其中的动物生命联系起来。书面殖民记录出现以前，各家庭群体依靠对林间小径和渡河的细致知识维持往来，辨识泛滥地面、隐蔽陆路转运点和安全季节通道。这些路径把渔场、园地和营地连接起来，无须经过单一中心。

季节性营地在水产、猎物和林果丰盛之处汇集家庭。园地随土壤和排水条件迁移，独木舟又把瓜波雷河及支流同邻近民族连接起来。交换网络运送食物、纤维、工具和仪式知识，却未抹去不同语言与地域。艾卡纳故土因此保存着由河畔村落、亲缘关系和地方知识组成的分散世界，而非单一永久城镇。

english:
Aykhal lies in the Vilyuy basin of western Yakutia, beside the Sokhsolookh River. The stream’s Yakut name means river of traps, recalling reindeer that drowned while crossing autumn ice. Taiga and low ridges surround the site, while long winters and frozen waterways set the rhythm of movement. Fish, game and reindeer linked winter camps, while trails followed the Vilyuy and its tributaries. Frozen rivers became winter roads, yet thin ice could trap a herd.

Sakha families combined horse and cattle raising with hunting and fishing, while Evenki communities followed reindeer across the forest and open uplands. Rivers supplied fish and routes, and the surrounding woodland offered fur, fuel and building material. Seasonal camps shifted with pasture, ice and the movement of game rather than fixed property lines. Summer water routes and winter ice roads met along the basin’s tributaries, while families adjusted camps to snowfall, flooding and the movement of animals. Hunters chose routes by ice and weather.

Russian exploration entered the Vilyuy country during the seventeenth century, followed by tribute posts, small settlements and trade in furs. Local families supplied transport, food and knowledge of winter routes while adapting to new demands from Yakutsk. By the eighteenth century the basin remained thinly settled, with scattered camps and river crossings. Aykhal’s early identity belongs to this northern landscape and to the Sokhsolookh’s remembered hazards rather than to a fixed urban community.
simp_chinese:
艾哈尔位于雅库特西部维柳伊河流域，濒临索赫索洛赫河。溪流的雅库特语名称意为“陷阱之河”，源于驯鹿在秋冰上渡河时溺亡的旧事。泰加林与低矮山脊环绕四周，漫长冬季和冻结水道决定往来节奏。鱼类、猎物与驯鹿把冬季营地联系起来，小径沿维柳伊河及其支流延伸。

萨哈家庭兼营马匹、牛群与渔猎，埃文基社群则带着驯鹿穿行森林和开阔高地。河流提供鱼类和路线，周围林地供应毛皮、燃料与建材。季节营地随牧场、冰情和猎物移动，而非固定在明确地界之内。夏季水运和冬季冰道在流域支流沿线相接，家庭则随积雪、汛情和动物移动调整营地。猎人依据冰情与天气选择路线。

十七世纪，俄国探险者进入维柳伊河流域，随后出现贡赋据点、小型聚落和毛皮贸易。地方家庭提供运输、食物和冬季路线知识，同时适应雅库茨克的新需求。到十八世纪，流域仍人口稀少，只有分散营地与渡口。艾哈尔的早期身份属于这片北方景观以及索赫索洛赫河保留的危险记忆，而非固定城市社群。

english:
Aikō occupied the middle of Sagami Province, from the Sagami River and Tanzawa Mountains northward toward Musashi. River plains, hills and mountain approaches created distinct farming and forest zones. Roads through the valleys connected coastal Sagami with the Kantō interior and the roads leading toward Edo.

During the Heian through Sengoku periods, the land formed part of a vast shōen held by the Ōe clan and their descendants, the Mōri of Chōshū. Distant proprietors claimed rice dues and labor from local cultivators while estate managers organized fields, water and villages. The Hōjō of Odawara and Takeda of Kai later contested the district during their struggle for eastern Japan.

Under the Tokugawa shogunate, authority became more fragmented. The area was nominally part of Odawara Domain, but much belonged to tenryō lands administered from Edo through hatamoto. After 1706 a branch of the Ōkubo clan established Ogino-Yamanaka Domain in part of the district, while other portions belonged to Karasuyama Domain. River and mountain boundaries thus supported overlapping estates, domains and direct shogunal holdings rather than one continuous town history. Local villages maintained irrigation, woodland and upland paths. Estate boundaries followed ridges and streams, and disputes over water reveal how local managers negotiated between villages and distant proprietors. Rice, millet and timber moved along valley roads toward markets near the Sagami River. Estate records linked rice dues with local festivals and irrigation duties.
simp_chinese:
爱甲占据相模国中部，从相模川和丹泽山地北伸至武藏国界。河原、丘陵和山地入口形成不同农作与林区。谷地道路把相模海岸同关东内地及通往江户的道路连接起来。

平安至战国时期，土地属于大江氏及其毛利氏后裔持有的大型庄园。远方领主征收稻米与劳役，庄官则组织田地、水利和村庄。后来小田原北条氏与甲斐武田氏在东日本争霸中反复争夺该郡。

江户幕府统治下，权力更加分散。地区名义上属小田原藩，大部分却是通过旗本自江户管理的天领。一七〇六年，大久保氏分支在郡内建立荻野山中藩，其他部分属乌山藩。河山边界因而支撑庄园、藩领与幕府直辖地交错，而非一条连续城镇史。当地村庄维护灌渠、林地和山道。庄园边界沿山脊溪流划分，水利争端显示地方庄官如何在村庄与远方领主之间协商。稻米、杂粮和木材沿谷路运往相模川附近市场。庄园账册把稻米年贡同地方祭典和水利义务联系起来。

english: The Ailao Mountains form a great wooded barrier through central Yunnan, where the plateau meets the southern ranges of the Hengduan Mountains. Their ridges divide the waters of the Yuan River from those of the Amo and Babian. The eastern slopes fall steeply toward the river valleys, while the western side descends more gently from remnants of a high plateau. Changes in elevation bring different bands of vegetation, from the warm valleys to the evergreen forests of the mountain heights.
simp_chinese: 哀牢山纵贯云南中部，在高原与横断山系南段交接处形成一道森林屏障。山脊分隔元江与阿墨江、把边江的水系；东坡陡降至河谷，西坡则从残留的高原面较缓地下降。随着海拔变化，植被也呈现不同的带状分布，从温暖河谷一直延伸到高处的常绿森林。

english:
Ailinginae is a coral atoll at the northern end of the Marshall Islands’ Ralik chain. Its twenty-five low islands contain only 2.8 square kilometers of land, yet they enclose a lagoon of 105.96 square kilometers. No point rises more than three meters above the sea. Mogiri and Eniibukku passages connect the sheltered lagoon to the open Pacific. Scrub, grasses and stands of Pisonia grandis cover a narrow, salt-touched surface, while the average daytime temperature is about 27°C and the main rainy season runs from September to November.

Álvaro de Saavedra made the first European sighting on 1 January 1528. He charted Ailinginae with Utirik and Rongelap as Islas de los Reyes, or Islands of the Three Wise Kings, because the date was close to Epiphany. The name belonged to the visitors’ calendar rather than to island society. Reef passages, low land and a large lagoon explain both how island life could exist here and why a community on such slight ground was exposed to changes arriving from beyond the horizon.
simp_chinese:
艾林吉纳埃环礁位于马绍尔群岛拉利克链北端。它的二十五座低矮小岛合计只有2.8平方公里陆地，却围出105.96平方公里的泻湖，地表最高处离海面不超过三米。莫吉里和埃尼布库水道把平静泻湖与外海相连。狭窄而受盐分影响的土地上覆盖灌丛、草类和皮孙木，白昼平均气温约27摄氏度，主要雨季从9月延续到11月。

1528年1月1日，阿尔瓦罗·德萨维德拉首次从欧洲人的航海记录中望见该环礁。他把艾林吉纳埃同乌蒂里克、龙格拉普一起绘作“三王群岛”，因为日期接近主显节。这个名称来自来访者的历法，并非岛内社会的称呼。礁口、低地和巨大泻湖既解释了岛上生活如何可能，也说明建立在一层薄岛上的社群为何容易受到地平线之外变化的影响。

english: The waters around Ailinginae lie in the northern Ralik chain, close to Rongelap. In early January 1528 Álvaro de Saavedra's expedition landed on what may have been an uninhabited islet of Ailinginae and replenished supplies for six days. Islanders from nearby briefly met the Spaniards before the expedition sailed west towards the Philippines.
simp_chinese: 艾林吉奈周围的水域属于拉利克群岛北部，靠近朗格拉普。1528年1月初，阿尔瓦罗·德·萨阿韦德拉的探险队在一座可能属于艾林吉奈的无人小岛登陆，补给六日。附近岛民与西班牙人短暂相遇，随后探险队向西驶往菲律宾。

english:
Ailinglaplap stretches across the Ralik Chain of the Marshall Islands as a triangular atoll of narrow islets around a broad lagoon. Fifty-six pieces of land total only 14.7 square kilometres, but enclose 750 square kilometres of sheltered water. Coconut groves, reef flats and fishing grounds sustain communities spread between Wotja, Jeh, Airek and Bigatjelang. Canoes were the ordinary road between islets.

Marshallese tradition connects the atoll with major creation stories, and its name carried high rank among the western islands. Local chiefs governed through sea-connected communities rather than a single dense town. Canoes linked the islets for fishing, gatherings and exchange, while the lagoon supplied both food and a protected route between reefs.

A British vessel sighted the atoll in the 1790s, and canoes met another British ship in 1803. European whalers and traders soon entered the region seeking water, provisions and coconut products. Copra became important in the nineteenth century, and German traders planted more palms before formal colonial rule.

The atoll’s society long combined chiefly authority with household fishing and agriculture. Taro pits, breadfruit and coconut provided staple food, while the ocean supplied fish and turtles. Those harvests were distributed through kin and rank, making the lagoon a political as well as an economic space. Ailinglaplap therefore entered the period of European contact as a settled chiefly landscape, not an empty anchorage. Canoe knowledge linked every harvest.
simp_chinese:
艾林拉普拉普环礁沿马绍尔群岛的拉利克链展开，三角形礁盘围出广阔潟湖。五十六座岛屿合计只有十四点七平方公里陆地，却环抱七百五十平方公里的受保护水域。椰林、礁坪和渔场维持着沃贾、吉赫、艾雷克与比加特杰朗等分散社区。独木舟则是岛间日常道路。

马绍尔传统把环礁同重要创世故事联系起来，地名在西部岛屿中也具有较高等级。地方酋长管理的是一组由海路相连的社区，而非单一稠密城镇。独木舟连接各岛，用于捕鱼、聚会和交换；潟湖既提供食物，也是礁体之间的一条受保护航路。

十八世纪九十年代，一艘英国船只望见环礁；一八〇三年，又有独木舟接近另一艘英国船。此后欧洲捕鲸者和商人进入附近海域，寻找淡水、补给和椰子产品。椰干在十九世纪变得重要，德国商人又在正式殖民统治以前增植椰树。

环礁社会长期兼有酋长权威与家庭渔业、农业。芋头坑、面包果和椰子提供主食，海洋则供给鱼类与海龟。这些资源通过亲属与等级关系分配，使潟湖同时成为政治和经济空间。欧洲接触到来时，艾林拉普拉普已是有固定聚落和酋长秩序的海洋世界，而非无人锚地。独木舟知识连接着每一次收获。

english: Aillik lies on the Labrador coast beside a sheltered bay whose head divides into two branches. Its Inuit name means “a place having sleeves”, a description of those branching waters; the offshore islands bear the same name. Archaeological finds indicate that Inuit used the site seasonally, possibly as early as 1500. Much older remains in the bay include longhouses of the Maritime Archaic people, who lived along this coast thousands of years before the Inuit arrived.
simp_chinese: 艾利克位于拉布拉多海岸的一处避风湾旁，海湾顶部分成两支。它的因纽特名称意为“有袖子的地方”，形容的正是分岔的水域；近海岛屿也使用同一名称。考古发现表明，因纽特人可能早在公元1500年左右就季节性地使用此地。湾内还有古老得多的海洋古风期长屋遗迹，其建造者在因纽特人到来数千年前便生活在这片海岸。

english: Ailuk is a long coral atoll in the northern Ratak chain, with islets lining the eastern side of its lagoon. Marshallese navigators travelled between its islands and neighboring atolls. In 1817 Otto von Kotzebue anchored at Ailuk for two weeks, meeting islanders and recording their customs during his survey of the eastern Marshall Islands.
simp_chinese: 艾卢克是拉塔克岛链北部的狭长珊瑚环礁，小岛排列在潟湖东侧。马绍尔航海者乘船往来环礁内外。1817年，奥托·冯·科策布在艾卢克下锚两周，在测绘马绍尔群岛东部期间与岛民相遇并记录他们的习俗。

english: Aim stands on the Maya, a river that crosses the mountain country inland from the Sea of Okhotsk before joining the Aldan. Here the Chiya enters the Maya from the left, adding its waters to the northward-flowing river. Wooded uplands and tributary valleys surround this stretch of the Maya, whose long course links the highlands near the coast with the great Lena river system.
simp_chinese: 艾姆位于马亚河畔。这条河流穿过鄂霍次克海内陆的山地，最终汇入阿尔丹河。奇亚河在这里从左岸注入马亚河，为北流的河水增添水量。森林高地与支流河谷环绕着这段河道；马亚河漫长的水程将近海高地与广大的勒拿河水系联系起来。

english: Aim Mocoylek is a name used by Mocoví communities in the southern Chaco and Santa Fe region. The Mocoví, or Moqoit, speak a Guaycuruan language and traditionally lived by hunting and gathering across the plains. In the eighteenth century Jesuit missionaries established settlements among Mocoví communities, including San Javier on the Paraná in 1743. These missions brought colonial institutions into a region where Indigenous peoples had long maintained their own territories.
simp_chinese: 艾姆莫科莱克是南查科与圣菲地区莫科维社群使用的名称。莫科维人又称莫科伊特人，使用瓜伊库鲁语族语言，传统上在平原上狩猎采集。十八世纪，耶稣会士在莫科维人中建立传教聚落，其中包括1743年建于巴拉那河畔的圣哈维尔。这些传教聚落将殖民制度带入原住民族长期拥有各自领地的地区。

english: Aimangala is an old fortified settlement in the Hiriyur country of central Karnataka. An inscription of 975 names it Ayyapamangala, and its massive fortifications include walls, gates and a surrounding moat. The village has a Vaishnava tradition and a temple dedicated to Virabhadra. Built and expanded in later centuries, the fort became a stronghold associated with Haidar Ali of Mysore, whose campaigns brought much of the surrounding country under his authority.
simp_chinese: 艾曼加拉是卡纳塔克中部希里尤尔地区的一处古老设防聚落。975年的铭文称其为艾耶帕曼加拉；规模庞大的防御工事包括城墙、城门和环绕的壕沟。村庄有毗湿奴派传统，也有供奉维拉巴德拉的神庙。堡垒在后来的世纪里修建扩展，成为与迈索尔海德尔·阿里有关的据点；他的军事行动使周围许多地区落入其权力范围。

english: The Aimchan is a tributary of the Chelasin in the mountainous country inland from the Sea of Okhotsk. Its waters belong to the Maya basin and ultimately reach the Arctic through the Aldan and Lena. The Dzhugdzhur mountains divide these northward-flowing rivers from short streams that descend to the nearby Pacific coast. Forested valleys and high ridges shape the landscape between the two great drainage systems.
simp_chinese: 艾姆昌河是鄂霍次克海内陆山地中切拉辛河的一条支流。河水属于马亚河流域，最终经阿尔丹河与勒拿河流入北极海洋。朱格朱尔山脉分隔这些北流的河流与流向附近太平洋海岸的短小溪流。森林河谷和高山脊构成两大水系之间的景观。

english: Aimi lies in western Hōki, beside the waters of Lake Nakaumi and the port town of Yonago. Kikkawa Hiroie began building Yonago Castle on Minatoyama in 1591; it was completed around 1602 under Nakamura Kazutada. His retainer Yokota Muraaki helped lay out the castle town, but in 1603 he was killed amid factional conflict, provoking an unsuccessful rising by his family. Yonago went on to become a political and commercial center of western Hōki.
simp_chinese: 会见位于伯耆西部，靠近中海和米子港镇。一五九一年，吉川广家开始在凑山修筑米子城，约于一六〇二年在中村一忠治下完工。家臣横田村诠协助建设城下町，却在一六〇三年的派系纷争中被杀，其家族起兵反抗，最终失败。米子后来发展成西伯耆的政治与商业中心。

english: The Aimoré were Indigenous peoples of the forested country between the Brazilian coast and the Rio Doce valley. Portuguese writers later called related groups Botocudos, after the ornaments worn in their lips and ears. Colonial expansion brought repeated attacks on their lands; in 1808 the Portuguese regent authorised a “just war” against Botocudo groups, who resisted but were also forced into settlements under military and missionary control.
simp_chinese: 艾莫雷人是生活在巴西海岸与多西河谷之间森林地带的原住民。葡萄牙人后来因相关族群佩戴的唇饰和耳饰而称他们为博托库多人。殖民扩张给他们的土地带来反复袭击；1808年，葡萄牙摄政王批准对博托库多群体发动“正义战争”。他们奋起抵抗，但也有人被迫迁入军人和传教士控制的聚落。

english: Northwest of the Ahaggar massif, Mouydir rises from the central Sahara in a chain of rocky heights and plateaux. Dry valleys radiate from the uplands, some losing their waters in the sands to the west. In sheltered gorges, pools known as gueltas retain water after the rains, an unexpected presence among the bare rock. The broken plateau forms part of the great desert country between the Ahaggar and the oases farther north.
simp_chinese: 阿哈加尔山群西北面，穆伊迪尔的岩山与高原耸立在中撒哈拉。干河谷从高地向四方延伸，有些水流最终消失在西方沙地中。避风峡谷里，称为盖勒塔的水潭能在雨后留住水分，成为裸岩之间难得的水源。这片破碎高原位于阿哈加尔与北方绿洲之间的广大沙漠地区。

english:
Ain Farah lies among the dry hills of northern Darfur, where a spring supplied water to a settlement of stone and brick. Ruined walls and buildings surround the central spring at the site, recalling a centre of power in a landscape crossed by long-distance caravan routes. Tradition associates it with Shau Dorshid, a ruler of the Tunjur, whose dynasty preceded the Fur sultans of Darfur.

The remains include traces of buildings identified with both Islamic and Christian traditions. Their interpretation has long been debated, but together they show the range of influences that reached this northern Darfur centre. The spring and the surrounding high ground made it a naturally defensible place in a dry region where permanent water was precious.
simp_chinese:
艾因费拉赫位于达尔富尔北部干旱丘陵间，一处泉水曾为石砖聚落提供水源。残墙与建筑环绕遗址中央的泉水，令人想起这片商队道路穿过的土地上曾有一个权力中心。传统将它与通朱尔统治者肖·多尔希德联系起来，其王朝早于达尔富尔的富尔苏丹。

遗迹中有被认为属于伊斯兰和基督教传统的建筑痕迹。它们的具体解释长期存在争议，但共同显示了这个达尔富尔北部中心受到的多种影响。泉水和周围高地使这里成为易于防守的地方，在常年水源珍贵的地区尤为重要。

english: Ain Galaka is an oasis in Borkou, south of the Tibesti mountains and northeast of Lake Chad. Beneath the sand of this desert country lies groundwater close enough to the surface to sustain palm groves and pasture. Date palms are a particular wealth of Borkou: once their roots have reached the water below, they can grow without constant irrigation, leaving their owners free to tend livestock as well as the oasis gardens.
simp_chinese: 艾因加拉卡是博尔库的一处绿洲，位于提贝斯提高山以南、乍得湖东北的沙漠中。沙地之下的地下水离地表不远，滋养着棕榈林和牧场。枣椰是博尔库的宝贵物产：树根长到足以汲取地下水后，便不需要经常灌溉，主人也因此能够在照料绿洲园地之余放养牲畜。

english:
Aïn Madhi is a small town and commune in Algeria's Laghouat Province, where the high plateau opens toward the northern Sahara. It serves as the seat of its district and lies among sparse pasture, dry wadis and routes between settled districts and desert markets. Springs and wells made small centers possible in a country where water controlled both farming and travel.

The settlement's most enduring place in history derives from Ahmad al-Tijani, founder of the Tijaniyyah Sufi order, who was born there. His teaching spread through the Maghreb and across the Sahara, and Aïn Madhi became a remembered origin point for communities far beyond Laghouat. Pilgrims, students and merchants carried the town's name through networks that joined North Africa, the Sudan and the eastern Mediterranean.

Dates, grain and livestock supported the local economy, while pastoral families moved between plateau grazing and desert-edge wells. The town's modest scale contrasts with the reach of its religious memory. Its identity rests on a spring-fed position on the Atlas high plateau and on the combination of Sufi scholarship, caravan traffic and rural exchange. Water governed both farming and travel.
simp_chinese:
艾因马迪是阿尔及利亚拉格瓦特省的一座小镇和市镇，位于阿特拉斯高原向北部撒哈拉展开的地带，也是同名区的区治所在地。周围分布着稀疏牧场、干涸河沟以及连接定居区与沙漠市场的道路。在一个由水源支配农耕和交通的地区，泉眼与水井使小型中心得以建立。

小镇最持久的历史联系来自提加尼耶苏菲教团创立者艾哈迈德·提加尼，他出生于此。其学说传遍马格里布并越过撒哈拉，艾因马迪因而成为远超拉格瓦特范围的社群所记起的发源地。朝圣者、学生和商人沿北非、苏丹地区与东地中海之间的网络传播着这座城镇的名字。

椰枣、谷物和牲畜支撑地方经济，牧户则在高原草场和沙漠边缘水井之间迁徙。城镇规模有限，宗教记忆的传播范围却很广。它的身份形成于阿特拉斯高原上类似绿洲的位置，也形成于苏菲学术、商队交通与乡村交换的结合。

english: Aïn Salah is an oasis in the Tidikelt, south of the stony Tademaït plateau. Its palm gardens and fortified settlements depend on water drawn from underground, in a region surrounded by gravel plains and dunes. Foggaras carry water through gently sloping galleries to channels that divide it among the gardens. The oasis belongs to a chain of settlements bordering the Tademaït, alongside the Touat and Gourara to the west and north.
simp_chinese: 因萨拉赫是蒂迪凯勒特地区的一处绿洲，位于多石的塔德迈特高原以南。棕榈园和设防聚落依靠地下水维持，四周是砾石平原与沙丘。福加拉以缓坡地下水道引水，再通过渠道分配至各处园圃。这处绿洲属于环绕塔德迈特高原的一系列聚落，与西面和北面的图阿特、古拉拉绿洲相连。

english: The Tademaït plateau stretches across the central Algerian Sahara between the oases of El Goléa and Aïn Salah. This immense hamada presents a surface of bare rock and dark stones, with eroded edges falling towards the surrounding depressions. On its southern side lies the Tidikelt, where the gardens of Aïn Salah depend on underground water. The stark plateau separates these cultivated islands from the oasis country farther north.
simp_chinese: 塔德迈特高原横跨阿尔及利亚撒哈拉中部，位于埃尔戈莱阿与因萨拉赫绿洲之间。这片巨大的哈马达表面遍布裸岩和深色石块，受侵蚀的边缘向周围洼地下降。高原南侧是蒂迪凯勒特地区，因萨拉赫的园圃依靠地下水维持。荒凉的高原将这些耕作岛屿与更北方的绿洲地区隔开。

english: Aïn Sefra lies among the Ksour Mountains, between Jebel Aïssa and Jebel Mekter, at the edge of the Sahara. A spring and gardens sustained the old ksar beneath a long ridge of sand. According to local oral tradition, the children of Mohamed Benchaïb, known as Bou Dekhil, founded the fortified settlement around 1586 after acquiring the land from neighbouring tribes for a thousand sheep.
simp_chinese: 艾因塞夫拉坐落在克苏尔山脉的艾萨山与梅克泰尔山之间，处于撒哈拉边缘。泉水与园圃支撑着长长沙脊下的古老堡村。当地口述传统称，穆罕默德·本沙伊卜，即布德希勒的子孙，约在1586年以一千只羊从邻近部落购得土地，建立了这座设防聚落。

english: Aínsa stands above the meeting of the Ara and Cinca in the Pyrenean country of Sobrarbe. Its compact medieval houses form a defensive edge around the plateau, while the fortified bell tower of Santa María served as a lookout. An arcaded square was laid out between the town and its older castle in the fourteenth century; in the sixteenth century the fortress was rebuilt on a larger scale.
simp_chinese: 艾因萨坐落在比利牛斯山区的索夫拉韦，俯瞰阿拉河与辛卡河的汇合处。密集的中世纪民居环绕高地，形成防御边缘；圣玛丽亚教堂坚固的钟楼则兼作瞭望塔。14世纪，城镇与旧城堡之间建起一座带拱廊的广场；16世纪，要塞又得到大规模重建。

english: Lake Ainslie lies in the western part of Cape Breton Island, surrounded by the wooded hills of Unama'ki. Its waters flow north into the Southwest Margaree River, which joins the Northeast Margaree before reaching the Gulf of St. Lawrence. The Mi'kmaq used the river system as a source of food and a route of travel and exchange. The lake and its rivers form a continuous waterway from the interior of the island to the gulf coast.
simp_chinese: 安斯利湖位于布雷顿角岛西部，周围是乌纳马基克林木覆盖的丘陵。湖水向北流入西南马加里河，后者与东北马加里河汇合，再流向圣劳伦斯湾。米克马克人利用这条水系获取食物，并作为旅行和交换的道路。湖泊与河流共同构成从岛屿内陆通向海湾海岸的连续水道。

english: The upper Columbia valley lies between the Rocky and Purcell mountains, with marshes and lakes along its broad floodplain. Ktunaxa people moved through this country with the seasons. In late summer they fished for spawning salmon in the Columbia; at other times they hunted deer and mountain sheep or crossed the Rockies to pursue bison on the plains. Camps in the wetlands preserve traces of their long presence.
simp_chinese: 哥伦比亚河上游河谷位于落基山脉与珀塞尔山脉之间，宽阔的泛滥平原上散布着沼泽与湖泊。库特纳哈人随季节在这一带活动。夏末，他们在哥伦比亚河捕捞洄游产卵的鲑鱼；其他时节则猎取鹿与大角羊，或翻越落基山前往平原追猎野牛。湿地中的营地遗存保留了他们长期居住的痕迹。

english:
Air Hitam lies in the Lamandau country of central Borneo, a lowland of swamp forest, blackwater rivers and seasonally flooded ground. The Lamandau and its branches, including the Bulik, Belantikan and Matu, form the main routes through dense tropical forest. Fish, timber, rattan and forest fruit supplied communities, while rivers carried goods between interior longhouses and downstream markets.

Dayak and Malay communities combined shifting cultivation, hunting, fishing and gathering with river trade. Swidden fields of rice and vegetables were cleared and allowed to regrow, while forest provided materials, medicines and game. Local leaders controlled access to land and river passages, and canoes linked settlements when overland roads were absent or difficult.

The wider Lamandau area belonged to the Kotawaringin Kingdom before later colonial administration. Downstream rulers drew revenue from forest products, trade and river traffic, while local communities maintained their own territorial rights. Air Hitam’s identity comes from this riverine rainforest world, where water, fish and forest products mattered more than fixed roads or large cities. River fish and forest fruit fed settlements. Small river ports connected swidden villages to downstream rulers. Rattan and resin entered long-distance trade.
simp_chinese:
艾尔希淡位于婆罗洲中部拉曼道地区，是沼泽林、黑水河与季节泛滥地组成的低地。拉曼道河及布利克、贝兰蒂坎、马图等支流构成穿越密林的主要路线。鱼类、木材、藤和森林果实供养社群，河流把内陆长屋同下游市场连接。

达雅克人与马来人把刀耕火种、狩猎、捕鱼和采集同河运结合起来。稻蔬园地在焚烧后轮休，森林提供材料、药物和猎物。地方领袖控制土地及河道使用，陆路缺少或难行时，独木舟连接聚落。

更广阔的拉曼道地区后来进入科塔瓦林金王国影响。下游统治者从林产品、贸易和河运征收收入，地方社群维持自己的领土权利。艾尔希淡身份来自这种河流雨林世界，水源、鱼类和林产品比固定道路或大城更重要。河鱼和森林果实供养聚落。小河港把刀耕火种村庄同下游统治者连接起来。藤和树脂进入远途贸易。

english: Southern Borneo faces the Java Sea along a low coast crossed by rivers from the forested interior. Estuaries and wetlands lie where fresh water meets the tides, while bays open south towards Java. The Kotawaringin and Sampit rivers are among the waterways reaching this long shore.
simp_chinese: 婆罗洲南岸面向爪哇海，来自内陆森林的河流穿过低平沿岸地带。河口与湿地分布在淡水和潮水交汇之处，海湾向南朝爪哇敞开。哥打瓦林金河与桑皮特河是流向这一漫长海岸的河流之一。

english: Airag Nuur lies beside a freshwater lake in the dry Great Lakes Depression of western Mongolia. The lake is joined to the much larger saline Khyargas Nuur by a channel that remains open through winter. Once the two lakes occupied one basin; their waters form part of a chain extending south towards Khar and Khar-Us. The contrast between freshwater and salt lakes is a striking feature of this inland basin.
simp_chinese: 爱亦剌黑位于蒙古西部干燥的大湖盆地，靠近一座淡水湖。湖水通过一条冬季也不封冻的水道，流入面积大得多的咸水湖哈尔嘎斯。两湖曾处于同一个盆地，后来成为向南延伸至哈尔湖与哈尔乌斯湖的水系。淡水湖与盐湖并存，是这片内陆盆地鲜明的特征。

english:
Aire stands on the Adour in Gascony, within the Tursan country of southwestern France. Its older name, Atura, is associated with the river. The town became a bishop's seat, and its religious buildings and position on the road to Santiago de Compostela connected it to a wider network of pilgrimage.

The church of Sainte-Quitterie above the town preserves an older apse and Gothic work from the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries. In 1814, during the fighting in southwestern France, Wellington's forces defeated troops under Marshal Soult near Aire. Vineyards remain a feature of the surrounding Tursan countryside.
simp_chinese:
艾尔坐落在加斯科涅的阿杜尔河畔，属于法国西南部的图尔桑地区。城镇旧名阿图拉与河流相关。这里曾是主教驻地，宗教建筑和通往圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉的道路，使艾尔与更广阔的朝圣网络相连。

城镇高处的圣基特里教堂保留了较早的后殿，以及十三至十四世纪的哥特式建筑部分。1814年，法国西南部战事期间，威灵顿率领的部队在艾尔附近击败苏尔特元帅的军队。周围的图尔桑乡野也以葡萄园为特色。

english:
The Ais occupied a long stretch of Florida's Atlantic coast along the lagoon that Spanish visitors called the River of Ais. Their towns and seasonal camps drew on fish, shellfish, turtles and plants from the coastal waters and woodland. Chiefs governed the towns under a paramount leader, whose settlement lay near the southern part of the lagoon.

In 1605 the Spanish governor sent Álvaro Mexía from St. Augustine to seek relations with the Ais. He recorded Pentoaya, a winter town at the meeting of the Banana River and Indian River lagoons. Nearly a century later, the merchant Jonathan Dickinson was shipwrecked to the south and travelled north through Ais country. His account of the journey described the people and towns he encountered before reaching St. Augustine.
simp_chinese:
艾斯人居住在佛罗里达大西洋岸一段漫长的海岸线上，西班牙来访者将沿岸潟湖称为“艾斯人之河”。他们的城镇与季节性营地利用水域和林地中的鱼、贝类、海龟及植物。各镇由首领治理，共同服从一位最高首领；后者的聚落位于潟湖南部附近。

1605年，西班牙总督从圣奥古斯丁派遣阿尔瓦罗·梅希亚前来寻求与艾斯人建立关系。他记下了彭托亚，这座冬季城镇位于香蕉河潟湖与印第安河潟湖交汇处。近一个世纪后，商人乔纳森·迪金森在南方海岸遭遇船难，向北穿过艾斯人的土地。他在抵达圣奥古斯丁前，记录了途中遇到的人们与城镇。

english:
Aishihik Lake, called Män Shäw, or “Big Lake”, in Southern Tutchone, lies in a broad basin of southwestern Yukon and drains south through the Aishihik River. Its sheltered northern bay is where fish came to spawn, and the hills around the lake offered good hunting for caribou and other game.

The old village of Äshèyi stood at the north end of the lake, and its name refers to the head or tail of a mountain range. Families returned there after seasonal hunting and fishing trips. Trails ran from the village along the western shore to Fort Selkirk on the Yukon River, and others led east to Long Lake and Hutshi, south to Klukwan, and west to Kluane Lake.

Southern Tutchone people guided Chilkat Tlingit traders who came inland from the coast, acting as middlemen between the Chilkat and the Northern Tutchone to the north. Artifacts from the old village include glass beads, engraved Tlingit mother-of-pearl buttons, dentalium shells and a copper arrow point, showing that goods moved through the lake country in both directions.
simp_chinese:
艾希希克湖在南塔琼语中称Män Shäw，意为“大湖”，位于育空西南部宽阔的盆地中，湖水向南经艾希希克河流出。北端的避风浅湾是鱼类洄游产卵之处，湖周山地则提供了驯鹿等野兽的良好猎场。

北端的旧村Äshèyi，其名意为山列的头或尾。各家在季节性狩猎和捕鱼之后都回到这里。道路从村子沿西岸通往育空河畔的塞尔扣克堡，另有支道向东通往长湖和胡奇，向南通往克卢克万，向西通往克卢恩湖。

南塔琼人为从海岸深入内陆的奇尔卡特特林吉特商人引路，并在他们与北方的北塔琼人之间充当中间人。旧村出土的遗物包括玻璃珠、刻花的特林吉特贝母纽扣、角贝以及一枚铜箭头，说明货物在湖区两个方向流动。

english: Aït Benhaddou rises beside the Ounila River in southern Morocco as an ighrem, or ksar: a fortified village whose houses, walls and corner towers crowd a hillside. Its position on a former caravan route between the Sahara and Marrakesh gave it strategic value. From the valley, travellers could reach the Tizi n’Tichka pass, one of the comparatively few crossings of the Atlas Mountains, linking Marrakesh with the Dra’a Valley and the desert edge. Other kasbahs and ksour stood along the same route, including Tamdaght to the north. Fortification at the site dates from the eleventh-century Almoravid period, but none of the present structures is thought to predate the seventeenth century. They continue older designs and methods. The buildings are made of rammed earth, adobe, clay brick and wood. Taller rammed-earth walls carry lighter adobe above, reducing the load. Such material was cheap and effective but permeable to rain; abandoned structures could begin crumbling within decades, and continued survival required regular repair. Inside the defences are dwellings of varied size, a mosque, a caravanserai, several kasbahs and a marabout. A public square, a Muslim cemetery and a Jewish cemetery reveal the social and religious life of the community. At the hilltop stand the remains of a large fortified granary, while grain was grown and threshed outside the walls.
simp_chinese:
阿伊特本哈杜沿乌尼拉河旁的山坡升起，是摩洛哥南部一座名为“伊格赫雷姆”或“克萨尔”的设防聚落。房屋、围墙与角楼密集依附山坡。它位于撒哈拉与马拉喀什之间的旧商路上，从河谷可通往蒂齐恩蒂奇卡山口；那是横越阿特拉斯山、连接马拉喀什与德拉河谷及沙漠边缘的少数通道之一。塔姆达格特等城寨也沿这条道路分布。

当地在十一世纪穆拉比特时期已经设防，不过现存建筑一般认为不早于十七世纪，其形制与营造方法却延续了更早传统。建筑使用夯土、土坯、泥砖和木材；较高的夯土墙承托更轻的土坯上层，以减轻压力。泥土材料成本低而实用，也会被雨水渗透，废弃房屋数十年内便可能崩塌，因此聚落能够保存下来，依靠的是持续维修。

围墙内有大小不一的住宅、清真寺、商旅客栈、多座卡斯巴和一处圣者墓。公共广场以及分别设立的穆斯林墓地和犹太墓地，显示这个社区的多重生活层次。山顶仍留有大型设防粮仓的遗迹，墙外土地用于种植和脱粒谷物。

english: Ait Daoud lies in the western interior of Morocco, between the Atlantic-facing Essaouira district and the wider Marrakesh hinterland. Its surroundings are hills, steppe and dry country, and local markets and tracks linked the scattered rural communities of the district with the coast and with Marrakesh.
simp_chinese: 艾特达乌德位于摩洛哥西部内陆，介于面向大西洋的索维拉地区与马拉喀什的内陆腹地之间。周围是丘陵、草原和干旱地带，地方市场与道路把分散的乡村社群同海岸及马拉喀什相连。

english: Aida occupies the northeastern part of Mimasaka, near the borders of Inaba and Harima. Through its mountain country ran the Inaba road between Tottori and Himeji, linking the Sea of Japan with the southern provinces. Ōhara prospered as a post town on the route. In the Edo period, the lords of Tottori and their entourages stopped here during their journeys to and from Edo, relying on the inns and services of the highway settlements.
simp_chinese: 英多位于美作东北部，接近因幡与播磨的边界。连接鸟取和姬路的因幡街道穿过山地，将日本海一侧与南方诸国相连。大原作为沿途宿场而兴盛。江户时代，鸟取藩主及随从履行参勤交代时在此歇宿，旅程依靠沿线宿场提供住所与服务。

english: Aitbulat is a burial place on the Sarysu near the mouth of the Karakemer, at the edge of the Dabyssyn sands. Memorial tombs along the river served as landmarks in the open steppe as well as places of reverence. The lower Sarysu provided winter quarters for pastoral communities and an approach across the arid Betpak-Dala. Nearby river valleys connected these pastures with the uplands of Ulytau.
simp_chinese: 艾特布拉特是萨雷苏河畔的一处墓地，位于卡拉克梅尔河口附近、达贝森沙地边缘。沿河的纪念墓不仅是受到尊崇的场所，也为开阔草原中的行旅提供地标。萨雷苏河下游为牧民提供冬季营地，也是横穿干旱的别特帕克达拉的入口；附近河谷将牧场与乌勒套高地连接起来。

english: Aitutaki is an island and lagoon in the southern Cook Islands, with low coral islets bordering a broad expanse of water. Polynesian communities settled it long before European ships arrived. In 1789 William Bligh sighted Aitutaki from the Bounty. In 1821 Papeiha, a Christian convert from Bora Bora, came to the island as a missionary.
simp_chinese: 艾图塔基是库克群岛南部的岛屿与潟湖，低矮珊瑚小岛围绕宽阔水面。欧洲船只到来很久以前，波利尼西亚社群已在此定居。1789年，威廉·布莱从邦蒂号上望见艾图塔基。1821年，来自波拉波拉的基督徒帕佩伊哈到岛上传教。

english:
Aitutaki is an almost-atoll in the Cook Islands: a volcanic main island, a triangular barrier reef and a lagoon containing fifteen low coral islets. The highest ground rises to Maunga Pu, while sandy flats and cultivable volcanic soil border the protected water. Archaeological remains place early Polynesian settlement within the first several centuries of the second millennium, and the island’s traditions name early voyagers and founders.

The western reef passage gave boats access to the lagoon near Arutanga; a smaller southern break served canoes and small craft. These entrances fixed the main routes between coral shallows, fishing grounds and inland settlements. Eight districts divided the island, each associated with a tapere land section and a mataiapo title under the island’s ariki. Reef and land were therefore bound together by both travel and chiefly authority.

HMS Bounty arrived in April 1789, shortly before the famous mutiny. From 1821 London Missionary Society teachers drew Aitutaki into a new religious network, and the Christian church at Arutanga became the oldest in the Cook Islands. The lagoon remained the island’s maritime heart: a sheltered route for canoes, fishing and the contact that reshaped island life.
simp_chinese:
艾图塔基是库克群岛的一座准环礁，由火山岩主岛、三角形堡礁以及容纳十五座低矮珊瑚礁屿的潟湖组成。岛上的毛恩加普山是最高处，沙洲与可耕作的火山土围着受礁体保护的水面展开。考古遗存表明，波利尼西亚人在第二个千年的最初几个世纪已经定居于此，地方传统也保存了早期航海者和建立者的事迹。

西侧礁门让船只能进入阿鲁坦加附近水域，南部一处较小的缺口则供独木舟和小船通行。这些入口确定了珊瑚浅滩、渔场与内陆聚落之间的主要路线。全岛分为八个区，每区包含若干塔佩雷土地单元，并由岛首阿里基之下的马塔伊阿波统辖。礁体与陆地因此通过航行路线和酋长权威紧密相连。

一七八九年四月，英国皇家海军“邦蒂”号抵达艾图塔基，不久后便发生了著名叛乱。自一八二一年起，伦敦传道会教师把当地纳入新的宗教网络，阿鲁坦加的教堂成为库克群岛现存最早的此类建筑。潟湖始终是岛屿的海上核心，供独木舟、渔业与对外交流使用。

english:
Aiud stands in a river valley in Transylvania, where it combines an old fortified centre with a surrounding territory of ten villages. Its name ultimately derives from Saint Giles, to whom the first church in the settlement was dedicated. Aiud is also known in Hungarian as Nagyenyed and in German as Straßburg am Mieresch, names that preserve the linguistic layers of a region shared among Romanian, Hungarian and German communities. At the town’s centre is the Aiud Citadel, an irregular pentagon enclosing numerous buildings within a perimeter of about 350 metres.

The earliest surviving written finds dates from 1293, while local tradition holds that the first stone watchtower was finished during the Mongol invasion of 1241. It thus records repeated struggles over the surrounding principality. Education gave the town another durable role.

Bethlen Gabor College, named after the prince, was founded in 1622 in Alba Iulia and later moved to Aiud after a period in Cluj-Napoca. The Reformed church inside the citadel serves the Hungarian community and is the town’s oldest church. Together, the compact defences and the college show how protection, religious life and learning shaped an urban centre in Transylvania.
simp_chinese:
阿尤德位于特兰西瓦尼亚的河谷，在旧有设防中心之外，还管辖十个村庄。其名称最终源自圣吉尔，当地第一座教堂即以他命名；城市在匈牙利语中称大埃涅德，在德语中称米耶雷什河畔施特拉斯堡，这些名称保存了罗马尼亚人、匈牙利人与德意志人社群共同塑造的地区语言层次。城中心的阿尤德堡垒是不规则五边形，周长约三百五十米，内部聚集多座建筑。

现存最早的书面迹象始于1293年，当地传统则说第一座石制瞭望塔在1241年蒙古西征期间建成。教育又赋予城市持久影响。

1622年，以加布雷尔·贝特伦王公命名的贝特伦·加博尔学院在阿尔巴尤利亚创办，后经克卢日短暂迁转而设于阿尤德。堡垒内的归正宗教堂服务于匈牙利社群，也是全城最古老的教堂。紧凑防御设施与学院由此共同说明，防护、宗教生活与教育如何塑造特兰西瓦尼亚的一座城市。

english:
Aivitok, 'place of the walrus' in Labrador Inuttitut, is the name of the great inlet on Labrador's coast known to English navigators as Hamilton Inlet. Its bays and channels reach inland towards Lake Melville, between wooded hills and rocky shores. Inuit families used the inlet as a wintering place, travelling along the coast in kayaks and larger skin boats.

The waters brought Inuit into contact with European visitors. In 1586 an encounter with John Davis's expedition ended in violence, with two members of his party killed. Nearly two centuries later, the trader George Cartwright recorded families arriving from Aivitok in a whaling boat and several kayaks. The many spellings of the name in European accounts preserve an older Inuit geography of this coast.
simp_chinese:
艾维托克在拉布拉多因纽特语中意为“海象之地”，是拉布拉多海岸一处大海湾的名称，英国航海者称之为汉密尔顿湾。海湾与水道深入林木覆盖的丘陵和岩岸之间，通向梅尔维尔湖。因纽特家庭以此为越冬地点，乘皮划艇和较大的皮船沿岸旅行。

海湾也见证了因纽特人与欧洲来访者的相遇。1586年，与约翰·戴维斯探险队的接触演变为冲突，探险队有两人遇害。近两个世纪后，商人乔治·卡特赖特记载，一些家庭乘一艘捕鲸船和数只皮划艇从艾维托克来到他的港口。欧洲文献中这一地名的各种拼法，保存了这片海岸更早的因纽特地理名称。

english: Aiwanj lies near the meeting of the Kafirnigan and the upper Amu Darya, the great river known in antiquity as the Oxus. Medieval geographers called this place Awdhaj or Udhaj, and some reckoned that the river acquired the name Amu Darya only below the junction. The Kafirnigan was also known as the river of Qubadiyan, after the district through which it flowed before reaching the Oxus.
simp_chinese: 艾万吉位于卡菲尔尼甘河与阿姆河上游汇合处附近。阿姆河在古代称为奥克苏斯河，中世纪地理学家称此地为奥扎吉或乌扎吉，有些人认为河流在汇合处下游才称作阿姆河。卡菲尔尼甘河流经库博季容地区后注入大河，因此也被称作库博季容河。

english:
Aix lies in the plain north of Marseille beneath the Montagne Sainte-Victoire, the Roman Aquae Sextiae and for centuries the capital of Provence. The counts of Provence, of the houses of Aragon and Anjou, made it their residence in 1189, and Aix grew into a court town with an archbishop, whose cathedral of Saint-Sauveur holds King René's altarpiece of the Burning Bush by Nicolas Froment. Louis II of Anjou granted the town a university in 1409.

Provence passed to the French crown in 1481 on the death of Charles III of Maine and was formally united in 1487, though it remained until 1789 an associated state with its own Estates and institutions. In 1501 Louis XII set up the Parlement of Provence in Aix, which became the great law court of the region. The clock tower of the town hall dates from 1510. In 1536 the army of Charles V invaded Provence and entered Aix. In the seventeenth century Archbishop Michel Mazarin, brother of the cardinal, laid out the regular streets of the Mazarin quarter south of the old town, and the Cours Mirabeau was planted on the line of the medieval ramparts. Pierre Pavillon built the new town hall between 1655 and 1678, and the intendants of Provence were based in the city.
simp_chinese:
艾克斯位于马赛以北、圣维克图瓦山下的平原上，即罗马的阿奎塞克斯提亚，数百年间是普罗旺斯的首府。属于阿拉贡和安茹家族的普罗旺斯伯爵们于1189年定居于此，艾克斯逐渐发展为设有大主教的宫廷城镇，圣救主主教座堂里藏有勒内国王的《燃烧的荆棘》祭坛画，作者是尼古拉·弗罗芒。安茹的路易二世于1409年授予这座城镇一所大学。

1481年缅因的查理三世去世后，普罗旺斯归入法国王室，1487年正式合并，但直到1789年仍是享有自己三级会议和机构的联合邦。1501年路易十二在艾克斯设立普罗旺斯高等法院，使其成为该地区的最高法院。市政厅的钟楼建于1510年。1536年，查理五世的军队入侵普罗旺斯并进入艾克斯。十七世纪，大主教米歇尔·马扎然，也就是红衣主教马扎然的兄弟，在老城南侧规划了整齐街道的马扎然街区，米拉波大道则栽植在中世纪城墙的位置上。皮埃尔·帕维永于1655至1678年建造了新市政厅，普罗旺斯总督也设在城中。

english: Aixe stands at the meeting of the Vienne and Aixette, west of Limoges. The castle of the viscounts of Limoges occupied a rocky spur above the confluence, guarding an approach to their city. Below its great tower and hall lay a fortified enclosure where knights kept houses from the thirteenth to the sixteenth century. Bridges over the two rivers connected the settlement beneath the castle to the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 埃克斯位于利摩日以西、维埃纳河与埃克塞特河的汇合处。利摩日子爵的城堡占据两河交汇处上方的岩岬，守卫通往城市的道路。城堡高塔与大厅之下，有一片设防的围地，十三至十六世纪间骑士们在此拥有宅邸。两条河上的桥梁将城堡下方的聚落与周围地区连接起来。

english: Northwest of Babeldaob, the sea approaches the largest island of Palau and its enclosing reefs. In 1783 the East India Company's Antelope struck a reef near Ulong, southwest of Babeldaob. Captain Henry Wilson and his crew built a replacement vessel with Palauan assistance and sailed away that November.
simp_chinese: 巴伯尔道布西北方的海域通向帕劳最大的岛屿及其环绕礁群。1783年，东印度公司的“羚羊”号在巴伯尔道布西南方的乌隆岛附近触礁。亨利·威尔逊船长和船员在帕劳人帮助下造出一艘替代船只，并于当年11月驶离。

english:
Aizkraukle lies on the Daugava River in Vidzeme, at a boundary between the historical regions of Vidzeme and Selonia. A high bank and nearby tributary stream offered a defensible place beside the great river route linking the Baltic interior with Livonian trading centres. Forests, fields and fisheries supplied the surrounding settlements, while the Daugava carried goods, armies and news across the region.

The Livonian Chronicle first mentions the Liv hillfort at Aizkraukle in 1204, when Livs and Lithuanians attacked Riga. It was then described as the easternmost Liv port on the Daugava, beyond which lay the lands of the baptized Selonians and Latgalians around Koknese and Jersika. The people of Aizkraukle were forcibly baptized in 1205. Burials in two nearby cemeteries contain around one hundred Liv and Latgalian graves from the tenth to twelfth centuries.

In the second half of the fourteenth century, the Livonian Order built a stone castle several kilometres downstream from the old hillfort. Known in German as Ascheraden, it guarded the river crossing and the road into Livonia. The older harbour and the newer fortress together show how the same Daugava corridor supported both local Liv settlement and the military order of the medieval Baltic frontier.
simp_chinese:
艾兹克劳克莱位于维泽梅的道加瓦河畔，处在维泽梅与塞洛尼亚历史地区的交界。高岸和附近支流在河路旁提供可防守的地点，这条大河把波罗的内地同利沃尼亚贸易中心连接起来。周围森林、田地和渔场供养聚落，道加瓦河则运送货物、军队和消息。

《利沃尼亚编年史》在一二〇四年首次提到艾兹克劳克莱的利夫人山堡，当时利夫人和立陶宛人进攻里加。文献称它是道加瓦河最东端的利夫港口，再往东便是科克内塞和耶尔西卡周边受洗的塞洛尼亚人与拉特加莱人土地。一二〇五年，艾兹克劳克莱居民被迫受洗。附近两处墓地出土约一百座十至十二世纪利夫人和拉特加莱人的墓葬。

十四世纪后半叶，利沃尼亚骑士团又在旧山堡下游数公里处修建石堡，德语称阿舍拉登。城堡控制河流渡口和通往利沃尼亚的道路。较早的港湾与较晚的堡垒共同说明，同一条道加瓦河走廊既承载利夫聚落，也支撑中世纪波罗的海边疆的军事统治。

english:
Ajaccio lies on the west coast of Corsica, sheltered at the foot of wooded hills on the northern shore of the Gulf of Ajaccio. The gulf, surrounding mountains, and low coastal plain made it a natural harbor and a difficult landing point for outside fleets. Its Corsican names, Aiacciu and Aghjacciu, have attracted several etymologies, including a legendary connection with Ajax, a derivation from a word for sheep pens, and Byzantine references that may describe a “good mooring.” The uncertainty reflects long contact among Greek, Latin, Italian, and Corsican cultures.

The ancient town declined during the Middle Ages, leaving the gulf sparsely urbanized while Corsica remained divided among local lords, communal institutions, and external powers. In 1492 the Genoese built a citadel south of the older settlement. Genoa used coastal fortresses to control the island and its trade, and the harbor beneath Ajaccio gradually became the center of a new town. The upper and lower levels of the town record this separation between fortified authority and the streets that grew along the waterfront.

Corsica’s internal politics reshaped the town in the eighteenth century. Pasquale Paoli proclaimed the Corsican Republic in 1755, but Genoa continued to hold several citadels, including Ajaccio. France intervened and eventually took control of the island. In 1769 Napoleon Bonaparte was born in the family house at Ajaccio, one year after France formally acquired Corsica.
simp_chinese:
阿雅克肖位于科西嘉西海岸，坐落在阿雅克肖湾北岸、林木覆盖的山丘脚下，海湾和群山使它成为天然港口，也使外来舰队难以直接登陆。科西嘉语名称 Aiacciu 和 Aghjacciu 有多种词源解释，包括与英雄埃阿斯的传说联系、源自羊圈一词，以及拜占庭文献中可能表示“良港”的名称。这种不确定性反映希腊、拉丁、意大利和科西嘉文化长期交汇。
